verses.1:1: The word of God that came upon Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests, who lived in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
verses.1:2: to whom the word of God came in the days of Josiah son of Amos, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.1:3: And it came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
verses.1:4: And the word of the Lord came to him:
verses.1:5: "Before I formed you in the womb, I know you, and before you came out, I have sanctified you; I have set you as a prophet to the nations."
verses.1:6: And I said, "O One Who Is, Master, Lord, look, I do not know how to speak, for I am young."
verses.1:7: And the Lord said to me, "Do not say, 'I am young,' for to all to whom I send you, you will go, and according to all that I command you, you will speak.
verses.1:8: Do not be afraid of their faces, for I am with you to rescue you," says the Lord.
verses.1:9: And the Lord stretched out His hand to me and touched my mouth, and the Lord said to me, "Look, I have put My words into your mouth.
verses.1:10: Look, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down and to destroy and to rebuild and to plant."
verses.1:11: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "A nut-tree staff."
verses.1:12: And the Lord said to me, "You have seen well, for I am watching over My words to perform them."
verses.1:13: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "A cauldron kindled from underneath, and its face is from the face of the north."
verses.1:14: And the Lord said to me, "From the face of the north evils will blaze out upon all who inhabit the land.
verses.1:15: For look, I am summoning all the kingdoms from the north of the earth," says the Lord, "and they will come, and each one will set his throne at the entrances of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls around her, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.1:16: And I will speak to them with judgment concerning all their wickedness, how they forsook Me and sacrificed to foreign gods and worshiped the works of their hands.
verses.1:17: And you, gird your loins, and arise and speak everything that I command you; do not be afraid of their faces nor be terrified before them, for I am with you to rescue you," says the Lord.
verses.1:18: "Look, I have set you on this day as a fortified city and as a bronze wall, strong against all the kings of Judah and its rulers and the people of the land;
verses.1:19: and they will fight against you, and they will by no means prevail against you, because I am with you to rescue you," said the Lord.
verses.2:2: And He said, "Thus says the Lord: 'I remembered the mercy of your youth and the love of his perfection, your following after the Holy One of Israel,' says the Lord.
verses.2:3: 'Holy is Israel to the Lord, the beginning of His produce; all who eat him will commit offense; evils will come upon them,' declares the Lord."
verses.2:4: Hear the word of the Lord, house of Jacob and every family of the house of Israel.
verses.2:5: Thus says the Lord: "What offense did your fathers find in Me, that they departed far from Me, and went after worthless things and became worthless?
verses.2:6: And they did not say, 'Where is the Lord who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us in the wilderness, in a boundless and untrodden land, in a waterless and fruitless land, in a land through which nothing passed and where no human being lived?'
verses.2:7: And I brought you into Carmel, for you to eat its fruits and its good things; and you entered and defiled My land, and you made My inheritance into an abomination.
verses.2:8: The priests did not say, 'Where is the Lord?' And those who hold fast to the law did not know Me, and the shepherds were acting impiously against Me, and the prophets were prophesying by Baal and went after what is unprofitable.
verses.2:9: Therefore I will still enter into judgment with you, and with the sons of your sons I will enter into judgment.
verses.2:10: For go to the islands of Kittim and see, and send to Kedar and consider carefully, and see if such things have happened,
verses.2:11: whether nations will exchange their gods, and yet these are not gods; but My people have exchanged their glory, from which they will not profit.
verses.2:12: Heaven was appalled at this and shuddered exceedingly much," says the Lord.
verses.2:13: "For My people have done two evil things: they forsook Me, a spring of water of life, and dug for themselves broken cisterns that will not be able to hold water.
verses.2:14: Is Israel a slave, or is he homeborn? Why has he become plunder?
verses.2:15: Lions roared against him and gave forth their voice, who turned his land into a wasteland, and his cities were torn down so as not to be inhabited.
verses.2:16: And the sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew you and were mocking you;
verses.2:17: has not your forsaking Me done these things to you?" says the Lord your God.
verses.2:18: "And now what do you have to do with the way of Egypt, to drink the water of Gihon? And what do you have to do with the way of the Assyrians, to drink the water of rivers?
verses.2:19: Your apostasy will discipline you, and your wickedness will reprove you; and know and see that it is bitter for you to forsake Me," says the Lord your God; "and I have not taken pleasure in you," says the Lord your God.
verses.2:20: "For from of old you broke your yoke; you tore apart your bonds, and you said, 'I will not serve You, but I will go upon every high hill and underneath every shady tree; there I will stretch myself out in my prostitution.'
verses.2:21: Yet I planted you as a fruitful vine, wholly genuine; how did you turn into bitterness, O foreign vine?
verses.2:22: Even if you wash with lye and multiply soap for yourself, you are stained in your iniquities before Me," says the Lord.
verses.2:23: "How will you say, 'I have not been defiled, and I have not gone after Baal'? See your ways in the burial ground, and know what you have done. At evening her voice wailed,
verses.2:24: she widened her ways to the waters of the wilderness; in the desires of her soul she was carried along by the wind; she was given over. Who will turn her back? All who seek her will not grow weary; in her humiliation they will find her.
verses.2:25: Turn back your foot from a rough road, and your throat from thirst. But she said, 'I will be strong,' for she had loved foreigners and was going after them.
verses.2:26: Like the shame of a thief when he is caught, so the sons of Israel will be put to shame, they and their kings and their rulers and their priests and their prophets.
verses.2:27: To the wood they said, 'You are my father,' and to the stone, 'You gave birth to me.' And they turned their backs to Me and not their faces; yet in the time of their troubles they will say, 'Arise and save us!'
verses.2:28: And where are your gods that you made for yourself? Will they arise and save in the time of your affliction? For according to the number of your cities were your gods, Judah, and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem they sacrificed to Baal.
verses.2:29: Why do you speak to Me? All of you have acted impiously, and all of you have acted lawlessly against Me," says the Lord.
verses.2:30: "In vain I struck your children; you did not accept discipline. A sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion, and you were not afraid."
verses.2:31: Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord: "Have I become a wilderness to Israel, or a barren land? Why did My people say, 'We will not be ruled over, and we will not come to You anymore'?
verses.2:32: Will a bride forget her ornament, and a virgin her breastband? Yet My people have forgotten Me for days without number.
verses.2:33: What good thing will you still devise in your ways to seek love? Not so; rather, you yourself have acted wickedly to defile your ways,
verses.2:34: and on your hands was found the blood of innocent souls; I did not find them in housebreakings, but at every oak.
verses.2:35: And you said, 'I am innocent; rather, let His wrath turn away from me.' Look, I am entering into judgment with you because you say, 'I have not sinned.'
verses.2:36: Why have you been so exceedingly contemptuous as to repeat your ways? By Egypt also you will be put to shame, just as you were put to shame by Assyria,
verses.2:37: for from here also you will go out with your hands on your head, because the Lord has rejected your hope, and you will not prosper in it."
verses.3:1: "If a man sends away his wife, and she goes away from him and belongs to another man, will she really return to him again? Will that woman not surely be defiled? And you prostituted yourself with many shepherds, and were you returning to Me?" says the Lord.
verses.3:2: "Lift your eyes straight ahead and see: where have you not been polluted? By the roads you sat for them like a deserted crow, and you defiled the land with your acts of prostitution and with your wicked deeds,
verses.3:3: and you had many shepherds as a stumbling block to yourself; you came to have the face of a prostitute; you were shameless toward everyone.
verses.3:4: Did you not call Me as a house, and father, and guide of your virginity?
verses.3:5: Will it remain forever, or will it be kept to the end? Look, you spoke, and you did these evil things, and you prevailed."
verses.3:6: And the Lord said to me in the days of Josiah the king, "Have you seen what the dwelling of Israel has done to Me? They went upon every high mountain and beneath every shady tree, and prostituted themselves there.
verses.3:7: And I said, after she committed all these acts of prostitution, 'Return to Me.' Yet she did not return, and faithless Judah saw her faithlessness.
verses.3:8: And I saw that on account of all the things that I also saw, on account of all the things in which the dwelling of Israel was caught in which she was committing adultery, I even sent her away and gave her a certificate of divorce into her hands; yet faithless Judah was not afraid, and she went and prostituted herself as well,
verses.3:9: and her prostitution came to nothing, and she committed adultery with the wood and the stone.
verses.3:10: And in all these things faithless Judah did not return to Me with all her heart, but in falsehood."
verses.3:11: And the Lord said to me, "Israel has justified his soul more than faithless Judah.
verses.3:12: Go and read these words toward the north, and you shall say, 'Return to Me, dwelling of Israel, says the Lord, and I will not set My face against you; for I am merciful, says the Lord, and I will not remain angry with you forever.
verses.3:13: Only acknowledge your unrighteousness, that you have acted impiously against the Lord your God, and have poured out your ways to strangers beneath every shady tree, and have not obeyed My voice, says the Lord.'"
verses.3:14: "Return, sons who have fallen away," says the Lord, "for I will rule over you, and I will take you, one from a city and two from a clan, and I will bring you into Zion,
verses.3:15: and I will give you shepherds according to My heart, and they will shepherd you, shepherding with knowledge.
verses.3:16: And it will be, when you multiply and increase in the land in those days," says the Lord, "they will no longer say, 'Ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel.' It will not enter the heart, it will not be named, nor will it be visited, and it will not be made again.
verses.3:17: In those days and at that time they will call Jerusalem 'Throne of the Lord,' and all the nations will be gathered into it, and they will no longer walk after the thoughts of their evil heart.
verses.3:18: In those days the house of Judah will come together to the house of Israel, and they will come as one from the land of the north and from all the countries to the land that I gave as an inheritance to their fathers."
verses.3:19: And I said, "May it be so, Lord!" For I will set you among nations, and I will give you a choice land, an inheritance of God Almighty of nations. And I said, "You will call Me Father, and you will not turn away from Me."
verses.3:20: "Yet as a woman breaks faith with her companion, so the house of Israel has broken faith with Me," says the Lord.
verses.3:21: A voice from lips was heard, of weeping and supplication of the sons of Israel, because they acted unrighteously in their ways; they forgot God, their Holy One.
verses.3:22: "Return, returning sons, and I will heal your fractures." "Look, we will be servants to You, for You are the Lord our God.
verses.3:23: Truly the hills were for falsehood, and the power of the mountains; yet through the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.3:24: And shame has consumed the labors of our fathers from our youth, their sheep and their calves, and their sons and their daughters.
verses.3:25: We have lain down in our shame, and our dishonor has covered us, because before our God we have sinned, we and our fathers, from our youth until this day, and we have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.4:1: "If Israel returns," says the Lord, "to Me he will return; if he removes his abominations from his mouth, and stands in awe before the presence,
verses.4:2: and swears, 'The Lord lives,' with truth, in judgment and in righteousness, then nations will bless in him, and in him they will praise God in Jerusalem."
verses.4:3: For thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and to those who dwell in Jerusalem: "Break up fallow fields for yourselves, and do not sow upon thorns.
verses.4:4: Be circumcised to your God, and circumcise your hardness of heart, men of Judah and those who dwell in Jerusalem, so that His wrath will not go out like fire and burn, and there will be no one to quench it, because of the evil of your practices."
verses.4:5: Declare in Judah, and let it be heard in Jerusalem; speak, sound a signal with a trumpet in the land, cry out loudly; say, "Gather together, and let us enter the fortified cities."
verses.4:6: Pick up and flee to Zion; hurry, do not stand still, for I am bringing calamities from the north and great destruction.
verses.4:7: A lion has gone up from his lair; a destroyer of nations has departed and gone out from his place to make the land a desolation, and cities will be torn down so that they are not inhabited.
verses.4:8: Because of these things, wrap yourselves in sackcloth, and lament and wail, for the wrath of the Lord has not turned away from you.
verses.4:9: "And it will be in that day," says the Lord, "the heart of the king will perish, and the heart of the rulers, and the priests will be appalled, and the prophets will be amazed."
verses.4:10: And I said, "O Master, Lord, have You utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, 'There will be peace,' and look, the sword has reached even to their soul?"
verses.4:11: At that time they will say to this people and to Jerusalem, "A spirit of error in the wilderness: the way of the daughter of My people is not for what is pure nor for what is holy.
verses.4:12: A spirit of fullness will come to Me; and now I speak judgments against them."
verses.4:13: Look, like a cloud he will come up, and like a whirlwind are his chariots; swifter than eagles are his horses. Woe to us, for we are ruined!
verses.4:14: Wash your heart clean from wickedness, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long do the thoughts of your troubles remain in you?
verses.4:15: For a voice of one announcing will come from Dan, and trouble will be heard from Mount Ephraim.
verses.4:16: Remind the nations; look, they have come! Declare in Jerusalem, "Bands are coming from a distant land, and they have raised their voice against the cities of Judah."
verses.4:17: "Like those guarding a field they have come against her all around, because you have neglected Me," says the Lord.
verses.4:18: Your ways and your practices have done these things to you; this is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it has reached even to your heart.
verses.4:19: I ache in my belly and in the senses of my heart; my soul is in turmoil, my heart is convulsed; I will not keep silent, for my soul has heard the sound of a trumpet, the shout of war.
verses.4:20: And it calls upon ruin, destruction, for all the land has been ruined; suddenly the tent has been ruined, my curtains have been torn apart.
verses.4:21: How long will I see those who flee, hearing the sound of trumpets?
verses.4:22: For the leaders of My people have not known Me; they are foolish sons and without understanding. They are wise to do evil, but to do good they have not known.
verses.4:23: I looked upon the earth, and look, nothing; and to heaven, and its lights were not there.
verses.4:24: I saw the mountains, and they were trembling, and all the hills being shaken.
verses.4:25: I looked, and look, there was no human being, and all the birds of heaven were terrified.
verses.4:26: I saw, and look, Carmel was desolate, and all the cities were burned with fire before the presence of the Lord, and before the anger of His wrath they were wiped out.
verses.4:27: Thus says the Lord: "All the earth will be desolate, yet I will by no means make a complete end.
verses.4:28: Because of these things let the earth mourn, and let the heaven above grow dark; because I have spoken and will not relent; I have set out and will not turn back from it."
verses.4:29: At the sound of a horseman and a drawn bow, every region withdrew; they slipped into the caves, and hid in the groves, and climbed up onto the rocks; every city was abandoned, no person was dwelling in them.
verses.4:30: And you, what will you do if you clothe yourself in scarlet and adorn yourself with golden ornament, if you paint your eyes with antimony? In vain is your beautifying; your lovers have rejected you; they are seeking your life.
verses.4:31: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in labor, of your groaning, as of one bearing her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion! She will grow faint and will let her hands drop: "Alas for me, for my soul fails because of those who have been killed!"
verses.5:1: "Run about in the streets of Jerusalem, and see and know, and search in her squares, if you can find whether there is one who does justice and seeks faithfulness, and I will be merciful to them," says the Lord.
verses.5:2: "The Lord lives," they say; therefore, do they not swear in falsehoods?
verses.5:3: Lord, Your eyes are toward faithfulness; You scourged them, and they did not feel pain; You consumed them, and they were not willing to receive discipline; they made their faces harder than rock, and they were not willing to turn back.
verses.5:4: And I said, "Perhaps they are poor, because they were unable, for they did not know the way of the Lord and the judgment of God.
verses.5:5: I will go to the prominent men and speak to them, for they themselves have come to know the way of the Lord and the judgment of God." And look, with one accord they shattered a yoke; they tore apart bonds.
verses.5:6: Therefore a lion from the forest struck them, and a wolf as far as the houses destroyed them, and a leopard kept watch over their cities; all who go out from them will be hunted down, because they multiplied their ungodly deeds; they grew strong in their turnings away.
verses.5:7: "For which of these things shall I be merciful to you? Your sons forsook Me and swore by those who are not gods; and I fed them to the full, and they committed adultery and lodged in the houses of prostitutes.
verses.5:8: They became horses mad for females; each one neighed after the wife of his neighbor.
verses.5:9: Shall I not punish for these things?" says the Lord, "or on a nation such as this shall My soul not take vengeance?"
verses.5:10: "Go up upon her battlements and demolish them, yet do not make a complete end; leave behind her supports, for they belong to the Lord.
verses.5:11: For the house of Israel has utterly acted treacherously against Me," says the Lord, "and the house of Judah
verses.5:12: lied to their own Lord, and they said, 'These things are not so; evils will not come upon us, and we will not see sword or famine;
verses.5:13: our prophets became wind, and the word of the Lord was not in them; so it will happen to them.'"
verses.5:14: Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty: "Because you spoke this word, look, I have made My words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.
verses.5:15: Look, I am bringing upon you a nation from afar, house of Israel," says the Lord, "a nation the sound of whose language you will not hear;
verses.5:16: all are mighty, and they will devour your harvest
verses.5:17: and your loaves of bread, and they will devour your sons and your daughters, and they will devour your sheep and your calves, and they will devour your vineyards and your fig groves and your olive groves; and they will thresh your fortified cities, in which you have trusted, with the sword.
verses.5:18: And it will be in those days," says the Lord your God, "I will certainly not make you into a complete end.
verses.5:19: And it will be when you say, 'For what reason has the Lord our God done all these things to us?' then you shall say to them, 'Because you served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land not yours.'"
verses.5:20: "Declare these things to the house of Jacob, and let it be heard in Judah.
verses.5:21: Hear now these things, foolish and senseless people: they have eyes and do not see; they have ears and do not hear.
verses.5:22: Will you not fear Me?" says the Lord, "or will you not stand in awe before My face, the One who appointed sand as a boundary for the sea, an eternal decree, and it will not pass over it; and it will be agitated, yet it will not prevail, and its waves will roar, yet they will not pass over it?
verses.5:23: But this people came to have a disobedient and rebellious heart, and they turned aside and went away.
verses.5:24: And they did not say in their heart, 'Let us now fear the Lord our God, who gives us early and late rain at the season of the fulfillment of the decree of harvest, and He preserved it for us.'
verses.5:25: Your lawless deeds have turned these things aside, and your sins have kept good things away from you.
verses.5:26: For ungodly men were found among My people, and they set snares to destroy men, and they kept capturing them.
verses.5:27: Like a set snare full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they became great and grew rich,
verses.5:28: and they transgressed justice; they did not judge the case of an orphan, and the case of a widow they did not judge.
verses.5:29: Shall I not punish for these things?" says the Lord, "or on such a nation as this shall My soul not take vengeance?
verses.5:30: Astonishment and horrible things have occurred upon the land.
verses.5:31: The prophets prophesy unjust things, and the priests clapped with their hands, and My people loved it so; and what will you do for the things after this?"
verses.6:1: Be strong, sons of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem, and in Tekoa give a signal with a trumpet, and over Beth-hakkerem raise a signal; for evils have peered out from the north, and great destruction is taking place,
verses.6:2: and your height will be taken away, daughter of Zion.
verses.6:3: To her shepherds and their flocks will come, and they will pitch tents against her all around, and they will pasture, each one with his hand.
verses.6:4: "Prepare yourselves against her for war; arise, and let us go up against her at midday! Woe to us, for the day has declined, for the shadows of the day are failing!
verses.6:5: Arise, and let us go up against her by night, and let us destroy her foundations."
verses.6:6: For thus says the Lord: "Cut down her trees; pour out a force against Jerusalem! O false city, all oppression is in her!
verses.6:7: As a cistern cools water, so her wickedness cools; ungodliness and misery will be heard in her, before her face continually.
verses.6:8: With pain and a scourge you will be disciplined, Jerusalem, so that My soul may not depart from you, so that I may not make you an untrodden land that will not be inhabited."
verses.6:9: For thus says the Lord: "Glean, glean like a vine the remnants of Israel; turn back like the grape-gatherer to his basket."
verses.6:10: To whom shall I speak and bear witness, that he will hear? Look, their ears are uncircumcised, and they will not be able to hear; look, the word of the Lord has become a reproach to them; they will certainly not desire it.
verses.6:11: "And I filled up My wrath and held back, and I did not consume them; I will pour it out upon infants outside, upon the assembly of young men together; for husband and wife will be captured, an elder along with one full of days;
verses.6:12: and their houses will be turned over to others, fields and their wives together, for I will stretch out My hand against those who inhabit this land," says the Lord.
verses.6:13: "For from the least of them even to the greatest, all have accomplished lawless deeds; from priest to false prophet, all have practiced false things.
verses.6:14: And they were healing the fracture of My people, treating it with contempt and saying, 'Peace, peace!' And where is peace?
verses.6:15: They were put to shame because they failed; yet not even as those being shamed were they ashamed, and they did not know their dishonor. Therefore they will fall in their falling, and at the time of visitation they will perish," said the Lord.
verses.6:16: Thus says the Lord: "Stand on the roads and look, and ask for the eternal paths of the Lord, and see which is the good way, and walk in it, and you will find purification for your souls. And they said, 'We will not go.'
verses.6:17: I have appointed watchmen over you; listen to the sound of the trumpet. And they said, 'We will not listen.'
verses.6:18: Therefore the nations heard, and those who shepherd their flocks.
verses.6:19: Hear, earth! Look, I am bringing evils upon this people, the fruit of their turning away, because they did not pay attention to My words, and they rejected My law.
verses.6:20: Why do you bring Me frankincense from Sheba and cinnamon from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices did not please Me."
verses.6:21: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Look, I am putting weakness upon this people, and fathers and sons together will grow weak; a neighbor and his companion will perish."
verses.6:22: Thus says the Lord: "Look, a people is coming from the north, and nations will be stirred up from the farthest part of the earth;
verses.6:23: they will grasp bow and spear; it is fierce and will not show mercy; its sound is like a surging sea; upon horses and chariots it will draw up in array like fire for war against you, daughter of Zion."
verses.6:24: "We have heard the report of them; our hands have grown limp; distress has seized us, birth pains like those of a woman giving birth."
verses.6:25: Do not go out into the field, and do not walk on the roads, for the sword of the enemies dwells all around.
verses.6:26: Daughter of my people, wrap yourself in sackcloth, sprinkle yourself in ashes; make for yourself mourning for a beloved one, a piteous lamentation, for suddenly misery will come upon you.
verses.6:27: "I have appointed you as a tester among tested peoples, and you will know Me when I test their way.
verses.6:28: All are disobedient, walking crookedly; bronze and iron, all of them are corrupted.
verses.6:29: The bellows has failed from the fire, the lead has failed; in vain the silversmith works silver; their wickedness has not melted away.
verses.6:30: Call them rejected silver, for the Lord has rejected them."
verses.7:2: Hear the word of the Lord, all Judea.
verses.7:3: Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Correct your ways and your practices, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.7:4: Do not trust in yourselves, in false words—for they will not benefit you at all—saying, 'The temple of the Lord, it is the temple of the Lord.'
verses.7:5: For if you truly correct your ways and your practices, and truly do justice between a man and his neighbor,
verses.7:6: and do not oppress the resident alien, the orphan, and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not walk after foreign gods to your own harm,
verses.7:7: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers from eternity to eternity.
verses.7:8: But if you trust in false words from which you will not be benefited,
verses.7:9: and you murder and commit adultery and steal and swear unjustly, and were burning incense to Baal and walking after foreign gods whom you do not know, so that it goes badly for you,
verses.7:10: and you came and stood before Me in the house on which My name has been called, and said, 'We have refrained from doing all these abominations.'
verses.7:11: Is My house, on which My name has been called, a cave of robbers there before you? And I, look, I have seen," says the Lord.
verses.7:12: "For you went to My place that is in Shiloh, where I made My name dwell formerly, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
verses.7:13: And now, because you did all these deeds, and I spoke to you and you did not listen to Me, and I called you and you did not answer,
verses.7:14: I will do to the house on which My name has been called, in which you trust, and to the place that I gave to you and to your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.
verses.7:15: And I will cast you away from My presence, just as I cast away your brothers, all the seed of Ephraim."
verses.7:16: "And you, do not pray for this people, and do not ask for them to be shown mercy, and do not plead, and do not approach Me for them, for I will not listen.
verses.7:17: Or do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.7:18: Their sons gather wood, and their fathers kindle a fire, and their women knead dough to make cakes for the host of heaven, and they poured out drink offerings to foreign gods in order to provoke Me to anger.
verses.7:19: Is it Me they are provoking to anger?" says the Lord. "Is it not themselves, so that their faces may be put to shame?"
verses.7:20: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Look, My anger and wrath are being poured out upon this place, and upon the people, and upon the livestock, and upon every tree of their field, and upon the produce of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched."
verses.7:21: Thus says the Lord: "Gather your burnt offerings with your sacrifices and eat meat.
verses.7:22: For I did not speak to your fathers and did not command them on the day I brought them up out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings and sacrifice;
verses.7:23: rather, I commanded them this word, saying, 'Listen to My voice, and I will be God to you, and you will be a people to Me; and walk in all My ways that I command you, so that it may go well with you.'
verses.7:24: And they did not listen to Me and their ear did not pay attention, but they walked in the thoughts of their evil heart, and turned backward and not forward,
verses.7:25: from the day their fathers came out of the land of Egypt even until this day. And I sent out to you all My servants the prophets, by day and at dawn, and I sent them,
verses.7:26: and they did not listen to Me and their ear did not pay attention, and they stiffened their neck more than their fathers.
verses.7:27: And you shall say this word to them:
verses.7:28: 'This is the nation that did not listen to the voice of the Lord and did not accept discipline; faithfulness has vanished from their mouth.'
verses.7:29: Shear your head and cast it away, and take up a lament on your lips, for the Lord has rejected and thrust away the generation that does these things.
verses.7:30: For the sons of Judah have done what is evil before Me," says the Lord. "They have set their abominations in the house on which My name has been called, to defile it;
verses.7:31: and they have built the altar of Topheth, which is in the Valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn up their sons and their daughters in fire, which I did not command them and did not consider in My heart.
verses.7:32: Therefore, look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and they will no longer say, 'Altar of Topheth' and 'Valley of the son of Hinnom,' but 'The Valley of the Killed'; and they will bury in Topheth because there is no place,
verses.7:33: and the corpses of this people will be food for the birds of the sky and for the wild beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to drive them away.
verses.7:34: And from the city of Judah and from the thoroughfares of Jerusalem I will put an end to the voice of those celebrating and the voice of those rejoicing, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, for the whole land will become a desolation."
verses.8:1: "At that time," says the Lord, "they will bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of its rulers, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of prophets, and the bones of those who dwell in Jerusalem out of their tombs,
verses.8:2: and they will dry them out before the sun and the moon, and before all the stars, and before all the host of heaven, which they loved, and which they served, and after which they walked, and to which they clung, and which they worshiped; they will not be mourned and they will not be buried, and they will be an example upon the face of the earth,
verses.8:3: because they chose death rather than life, and to all the remaining ones who are left from that generation, in every place wherever I drive them out."
verses.8:4: For thus says the Lord: "Does the one who falls not get up? Or does the one who turns away not turn back?
verses.8:5: Why has this people of Mine turned away with a shameless turning away, and been held fast in their choice, and refused to turn back?
verses.8:6: Give ear now and listen; they will not speak thus. There is no one repenting of his wickedness, saying, 'What have I done?' The runner has ceased from his course, like a horse drenched in sweat in its neighing.
verses.8:7: Even the stork in the sky knows its season; turtledove and swallow of the field, sparrows keep the seasons of their arrivals; but My people do not know the judgments of the Lord.
verses.8:8: How will you say, 'We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us'? A false reed pen has proved in vain for scribes.
verses.8:9: The wise have been put to shame, and dismayed, and captured, because they have rejected the law of the Lord; what wisdom is in them?
verses.8:10: Therefore I will give their wives to others, and their fields to heirs,
verses.8:13: and they will gather their produce," says the Lord. "There are no grapes on the vines, and there are no figs on the fig trees, and the leaves have fallen off."
verses.8:14: "Why are we sitting here? Gather together and let us enter the fortified cities and be cast away, for God has cast us away and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned before Him.
verses.8:15: We were gathered for peace, and there were no good things; for a time of healing, and look, alarm."
verses.8:16: From Dan we will hear the sound of the swiftness of his horses; at the sound of the neighing of the riding of his horses, the whole land shook; and he will come and devour the land and its fullness, a city and those who dwell in it.
verses.8:17: "For look, I am sending out among you deadly serpents, which cannot be charmed, and they will bite you
verses.8:18: incurably with pain, while your heart is perplexed."
verses.8:19: Look, the sound of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land far away: "Is the Lord not in Zion? Or is a king not there?" "Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images and with foreign vanities?"
verses.8:20: "Summer has passed, harvest has gone by, and we have not been saved."
verses.8:21: Over the shattering of the daughter of my people I have been darkened; in perplexity, birth pangs like those of a woman giving birth have overpowered me.
verses.8:22: Is there no resin in Gilead, or is there no physician there? Why has healing for the daughter of my people not come up?
verses.8:23: Who will give water to my head and a spring of tears to my eyes, so that I may weep for this people of mine day and night, the wounded of the daughter of my people?
verses.9:1: Who would give me an outermost lodging place in the wilderness, and I will leave my people and go away from them? For they all commit adultery, an assembly of treacherous ones,
verses.9:2: and they bent their tongue like a bow; falsehood and not faithfulness prevailed upon the land, for they went out from evils to evils, and they did not know Me.
verses.9:3: Guard yourselves, each one from his neighbor, and do not trust in their brothers; for every brother will trip up by the heel, and every friend will walk deceitfully.
verses.9:4: Each one will mock his friend; they will by no means speak truth. Their tongue has learned to speak falsehoods; they acted unjustly and did not cease so as to turn back.
verses.9:5: Usury upon usury, and deceit upon deceit; they were not willing to know Me.
verses.9:6: Therefore, thus says the Lord: "Look, I will refine them by fire and test them, for I will act because of the wickedness of the daughter of My people.
verses.9:7: A wounding arrow is their tongue; deceitful are the words of their mouth. To his neighbor he speaks peaceable things, and within himself he holds enmity.
verses.9:8: Shall I not bring punishment for these things," says the Lord, "or on a people such as this shall My soul not take vengeance?
verses.9:9: Over the mountains take up wailing, and over the paths of the wilderness a dirge, for they have failed because there are no people; they did not hear the sound of possessions. From the birds of the sky even to the livestock, they panicked, they were gone.
verses.9:10: And I will give Jerusalem over to deportation and into a dwelling place of dragons, and the cities of Judah I will make a desolation, without being inhabited."
verses.9:11: Who is the man of understanding? Then let him understand this; and the one to whom the word of the mouth of the Lord comes, let him declare to you for what reason the land has perished; it has been set on fire like a wilderness, without being passed through.
verses.9:12: And the Lord said to me, "Because they have forsaken My law which I set before them, and did not listen to My voice,
verses.9:13: but walked after the pleasing things of their evil heart and after the idols that their fathers taught them.
verses.9:14: Therefore, thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: 'Look, I will feed them distresses, and I will give them water of gall to drink,
verses.9:15: and I will scatter them among the nations whom they and their fathers did not know, and I will send the sword upon them until I completely consume them by it.'"
verses.9:16: Thus says the Lord: "Call the mourning women, and let them come, and send to the skilled women, and let them speak out,
verses.9:17: and let them take up a dirge over you, and let your eyes pour down tears, and let your eyelids flow with water,
verses.9:18: for a voice of lamentation was heard in Zion: 'How we have been ruined! We have been greatly put to shame, because we have forsaken the land and have cast away our dwellings.'"
verses.9:19: Hear now, women, the word of God, and let your ears receive the words of His mouth, and teach your daughters lamentation, and each woman her neighbor a dirge.
verses.9:20: For death has climbed up through your windows; it has entered into your land to wipe out little children from outside and young men from the squares.
verses.9:21: And the dead bodies of people will be as an example upon the face of the field of your land, like grass behind a harvester, and there will be no one gathering.
verses.9:22: Thus says the Lord: "Do not let the wise man boast in his wisdom, and do not let the strong man boast in his strength, and do not let the rich man boast in his wealth,
verses.9:23: but rather let the one who boasts boast in this: to understand and to know that I am the Lord, who practices mercy and judgment and righteousness upon the earth; for in these things is My will," says the Lord.
verses.9:24: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will bring punishment upon all who are circumcised in their foreskins,
verses.9:25: upon Egypt and upon Idumea and upon Edom, and upon the sons of Ammon and upon the sons of Moab, and upon everyone who shaves around his face, those who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised in flesh, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in their heart."
verses.10:1: Hear the word of the Lord which He spoke concerning you, house of Israel.
verses.10:2: Thus says the Lord: "Do not learn according to the ways of the nations, and do not be afraid of the signs of heaven, for they fear them in their faces.
verses.10:3: For the customs of the nations are vain; it is wood cut out from the forest, a work of a craftsman and a cast image,
verses.10:4: adorned with silver and gold; with hammers and nails they fastened them.
verses.10:5: They will set them up, and they will not move; it is hammered silver; they will not walk.
verses.10:9: Plated silver will come from Tarshish, gold of Mophaz, and the hand of goldsmiths; all are works of artisans. They will clothe them in blue and purple. Surely they will be carried, for they will not take a step. Do not be afraid of them, for they will by no means do harm, and there is no good in them."
verses.10:11: Thus you shall say to them: "Gods who did not make heaven and earth, let them perish from the earth and from beneath this heaven."
verses.10:12: It is the Lord who made the earth by His strength, who established the inhabited world by His wisdom, and by His understanding He stretched out heaven
verses.10:13: and a multitude of water in heaven, and He brought up clouds from the end of the earth; He made lightning flashes for rain, and He brought out light from His storehouses.
verses.10:14: Every person has been made foolish, without knowledge; every goldsmith has been put to shame over his carved images, for he cast falsehoods; there is no breath in them.
verses.10:15: They are vain, works of mockery; in the time of their visitation they will perish.
verses.10:16: Such is not the portion of Jacob, for the One who formed all things, He is his inheritance; the Lord is His name.
verses.10:17: He has gathered your substance from outside, you who dwell in choice places.
verses.10:18: For thus says the Lord: "Look, I am overthrowing those who dwell in this land in affliction, so that your wound may be found."
verses.10:19: Woe over your shattering! Painful is your wound. And I said, "Truly this is your injury, and it has overtaken you."
verses.10:20: Your tent has been ruined, it has perished, and all your curtains have been torn apart; my sons and my sheep are no more; there is no longer a place for my tent, a place for my curtains.
verses.10:21: For the shepherds acted foolishly and did not seek the Lord; therefore all the pasture did not understand, and they were scattered.
verses.10:22: Look, a sound of a report is coming, and a great shaking from the land of the north, to make the cities of Judah a desolation and a resting place of ostriches.
verses.10:23: I know, Lord, that a human being's way is not his own, nor will a man walk and direct his own course.
verses.10:24: Discipline us, Lord, yet in judgment and not in wrath, so that You do not make us few.
verses.10:25: Pour out Your wrath upon the nations that do not know You and upon the generations that have not called upon Your name. For they have devoured Jacob and completely consumed him, and they have laid waste his pasture.
verses.11:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.11:2: "Hear the words of this covenant, and you shall speak to the men of Judah and to those who dwell in Jerusalem,
verses.11:3: and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: Cursed is the man who will not listen to the words of this covenant,
verses.11:4: which I commanded your fathers on the day when I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, "Listen to My voice, and do all that I command you, and you shall be a people to Me, and I will be God to you,"
verses.11:5: so that I may confirm My oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day.'" And I answered and said, "May it be so, Lord."
verses.11:6: And the Lord said to me, "Read aloud these words in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, saying, 'Hear the words of this covenant and do them.'"
verses.11:8: And they did not do so.
verses.11:9: And the Lord said to me, "A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among those who dwell in Jerusalem;
verses.11:10: they have turned back to the iniquities of their earlier fathers, who were not willing to listen to My words; and look, they themselves are going after foreign gods to serve them, and the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.11:11: Therefore, thus says the Lord: 'Look, I am bringing calamities upon this people from which they will not be able to come out, and they will cry out to Me, and I will not listen to them.
verses.11:12: And the cities of Judah and those who dwell in Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense; they will certainly not save them in the time of their calamities.
verses.11:13: For according to the number of your cities were your gods, Judah, and according to the number of the ways out of Jerusalem you set up altars to burn incense to Baal.'
verses.11:14: And as for you, do not pray for this people, and do not plead for them in supplication and prayer, for I will not listen in the time when they call upon Me, in the time of their affliction.
verses.11:15: Why has the beloved one committed an abomination in My house? Will vows and holy meats take away your wickednesses from you, or by these will you escape?
verses.11:16: A beautiful olive tree, well-shaded in appearance, the Lord called your name; at the sound of its circumcision fire was kindled against it, great is the affliction upon you, its branches have been made useless,
verses.11:17: and the Lord, who planted you, has spoken calamities against you in return for the wickedness of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, because they acted for themselves to provoke Me to anger by burning incense to Baal."
verses.11:18: Lord, make it known to me, and I will know; then I saw their practices,
verses.11:19: but I, like an innocent lamb being led to be sacrificed, did not know. Against me they devised an evil plot, saying, "Come, and let us cast wood into his bread, and let us wipe him out from the land of the living, and his name will never be remembered again."
verses.11:20: Lord, who judges righteously, who tests kidneys and hearts, may I see the vengeance from You upon them, for to You I have revealed my righteous cause.
verses.11:21: Therefore, thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth who seek my life, who say, "You shall by no means prophesy in the name of the Lord, or else you will die by our hands":
verses.11:22: "Look, I will bring punishment upon them: their young men will die by the sword, and their sons and their daughters will perish by famine,
verses.11:23: and there will be no remnant of them, for I will bring calamities upon those who dwell in Anathoth in the year of their punishment."
verses.12:1: You are righteous, Lord, that I will make a defense to You; yet I will speak judgments to You. Why is it that the way of the ungodly prospers? Have all those who deal treacherously with acts of treachery thrived?
verses.12:2: You planted them, and they took root; they bore children and produced fruit. You are near to their mouth, and far from their kidneys.
verses.12:3: And You, Lord, know me; You have tested my heart before You. Purify them for the day of their slaughter.
verses.12:4: How long will the land mourn, and all the grass of the field wither, because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it? Livestock and birds have vanished, because they said, "God will not see our ways."
verses.12:5: Your feet run and exhaust you; how will you prepare yourself for horses? And in a land of peace you are not confident; how will you do in the roaring of the Jordan?
verses.12:6: For even your brothers and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; and they themselves cried out, they gathered together from behind you. Do not trust in them, because they speak good things to you.
verses.12:7: I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance; I have given My beloved soul into the hands of her enemies.
verses.12:8: My inheritance became to Me like a lion in a forest; it gave its voice against Me; therefore I hated it.
verses.12:9: Is My inheritance a hyena's cave to Me, or a cave around it? Go, gather all the wild beasts of the field, and let them come to eat it.
verses.12:10: Many shepherds have ruined My vineyard; they have defiled My portion; they have turned My desirable portion into an untrodden wilderness;
verses.12:11: it was made a desolation of destruction; because of Me the whole land has been desolated with desolation, because there is no man taking it to heart.
verses.12:12: Upon every pass in the wilderness destroyers have come, because a sword of the Lord will devour from the end of the land; there is no peace for any flesh.
verses.12:13: Sow wheat, and reap thorns; their lots will not profit them. Be ashamed because of your boasting, because of reproach before the Lord.
verses.12:14: For thus says the Lord concerning all the wicked neighbors who touch My inheritance which I apportioned to My people Israel: "Look, I am tearing them away from their land, and I will cast Judah out from their midst.
verses.12:15: And it will happen, after I have cast them out, I will turn back and have mercy on them, and I will settle them, each one into his inheritance and each one into his land.
verses.12:16: And it will happen, if they truly learn the way of My people to swear by My name, 'The Lord lives,' just as they taught My people to swear by Baal, then it will be built up in the midst of My people;
verses.12:17: but if they do not turn back, then I will remove that nation with removal and destruction."
verses.13:1: Thus says the Lord: "Go and acquire for yourself a linen loincloth, and put it around your waist, and it shall not pass through water."
verses.13:2: And I acquired the loincloth according to the word of the Lord, and put it around my waist.
verses.13:3: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.13:4: "Take the loincloth that is around your waist, and arise and go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in the cleft of the rock."
verses.13:5: And I went and hid it at the Euphrates, just as the Lord commanded me.
verses.13:6: And it happened after many days that the Lord said to me, "Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the loincloth which I commanded you to hide there."
verses.13:7: And I went to the Euphrates River and dug, and took the loincloth from the place where I had buried it; and look, it was ruined—it would by no means be used for anything.
verses.13:8: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.13:9: "Thus says the Lord: In this way I will ruin the arrogance of Judah and the arrogance of Jerusalem,
verses.13:10: this great arrogance—those who are unwilling to obey My words and who have gone after foreign gods to serve them and to bow down to them; and they will be like this loincloth, which will not be used for anything.
verses.13:11: For just as the loincloth clings around a man's waist, so I made the house of Israel and the entire house of Judah cling to Myself, to become for Me a renowned people and a boast and a glory; yet they did not listen to Me.
verses.13:12: And you will say to this people, 'Every wineskin will be filled with wine.' And it will happen, if they say to you, 'Do we not surely know that every wineskin will be filled with wine?'
verses.13:13: then you will say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Look, I am filling those who dwell in this land, and their kings, the sons of David who sit on their throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and Judah, and all those who dwell in Jerusalem, with drunkenness,
verses.13:14: and I will scatter them, a man and his brother, and their fathers and their sons together. I will not yearn, says the Lord, and I will not spare and I will not have compassion from their ruin.'"
verses.13:15: Listen and give ear, and do not be lifted up, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.13:16: Give glory to the Lord your God before it grows dark, and before your feet stumble upon dark mountains; and you will wait for light, and there is the shadow of death, and they will be put into darkness.
verses.13:17: But if you do not listen, your soul will weep in secret because of arrogance, and your eyes will bring down tears, because the flock of the Lord has been crushed.
verses.13:18: Say to the king and to those who rule, "Humble yourselves and sit down, because the crown of your glory has been taken down from your head."
verses.13:19: The cities toward the south were shut up, and there was no one to open them; Judah was exiled; they completed a complete exile.
verses.13:20: Lift up your eyes, Jerusalem, and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, the sheep of your glory?
verses.13:21: What will you say when they inspect you? And you yourself taught them lessons against yourself for rule. Will not birth pains seize you like a woman giving birth?
verses.13:22: And if you say in your heart, "Why have these things happened to me?"—because of the abundance of your injustice your back parts have been uncovered, so that your heels are exposed to disgrace.
verses.13:23: Will an Ethiopian change his skin, and a leopard its spots? Then you also will be able to do good, having learned evil things.
verses.13:24: And I scattered them like dry brushwood carried by wind into a wilderness.
verses.13:25: This is your lot and the portion of your disobeying Me, says the Lord; since you forgot Me and hoped in lies,
verses.13:26: I also will uncover your back parts over your face, and your dishonor will be seen,
verses.13:27: and your adultery, and your neighing, and the alienation of your prostitution. On the hills and in the fields I have seen your abominations. Woe to you, Jerusalem, because you have not been cleansed after Me; how much longer?
verses.14:1: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.
verses.14:2: Judea mourned, and her gates were emptied, and they grew dark upon the ground, and the outcry of Jerusalem went up.
verses.14:3: And her nobles sent their young men for water; they came to the wells and did not find water, and they brought back their vessels empty.
verses.14:4: And the works of the land failed, because there was no rain; the farmers were ashamed; they covered their heads.
verses.14:5: Even does in the field bore young and forsook them, because there was no vegetation.
verses.14:6: Wild donkeys stood on glens; they drew in wind; their eyes failed, because there was no grass.
verses.14:7: Our sins have stood against us; Lord, act for us for Your sake, because our sins are many before You, because we have sinned against You.
verses.14:8: Hope of Israel, Lord, and You save in a time of evils: why have You become like a sojourner in the land, and like a native turning aside to a lodging place?
verses.14:9: Will You be like a sleeping person, or like a man unable to save? Yet You are among us, Lord, and Your name has been called upon us; do not forget us.
verses.14:10: Thus the Lord says to this people: "They have loved to move their feet and have not spared them, and God has not prospered in them; now He will remember their injustice."
verses.14:11: And the Lord said to me, "Do not pray for this people for good,
verses.14:12: because if they fast, I will not listen to their supplication, and if they offer burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will not be pleased with them; for by sword and by famine and by death I will bring them to an end."
verses.14:13: And I said, "O One Who Is, Lord, look, their prophets are prophesying and saying, 'You will not see a sword, nor will famine be among you, for I will give truth and peace upon the land and in this place.'"
verses.14:14: And the Lord said to me, "The prophets are prophesying false things in My name; I did not send them, and I did not command them, and I did not speak to them; for false visions and divinations and omens and the choices of their heart they themselves are prophesying to you.
verses.14:15: Therefore, thus says the Lord concerning the prophets who prophesy false things in My name, and I did not send them, who say, 'Sword and famine will not be in this land': By a diseased death they will die, and by famine the prophets will be brought to an end,
verses.14:16: and the people to whom they are prophesying, and they will be thrown out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the sword and the famine, and there will be no one to bury them—and their wives and their sons and their daughters—and I will pour out upon them their evils.
verses.14:17: And you will say this word to them: 'Bring down tears upon your eyes day and night, and let them not cease, because the daughter of my people has been crushed with a crushing, and with an exceedingly painful blow.
verses.14:18: If I go out into the plain, look, those wounded by the sword! And if I enter the city, look, the pain of famine! For priest and prophet have gone into a land which they did not know.'"
verses.14:19: Have You completely rejected Judah, and has Your soul departed from Zion? Why have You struck us, and there is no healing for us? We waited for peace, and there were no good things; for a time of healing, and look, turmoil!
verses.14:20: We know, Lord, our sins, the injustices of our fathers, because we have sinned before You.
verses.14:21: Relent for the sake of Your name; do not destroy the throne of Your glory; remember, do not break Your covenant with us.
verses.14:22: Is there among the idols of the nations one who brings rain? And will the sky give its abundance? Are You not He? And we will wait for You, Lord, because You have made all these things.
verses.15:1: And the Lord said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel stand before My face, My soul is not toward them; send this people away, and let them go out.
verses.15:2: And it will be, if they say to you, 'Where shall we go out?' then you will say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: As many as are for death, to death; and as many as are for the sword, to the sword; and as many as are for famine, to famine; and as many as are for captivity, to captivity.
verses.15:3: And I will punish them with four kinds, says the Lord: the sword for slaughter, and the dogs for tearing apart, and the wild beasts of the earth and the birds of the sky for devouring and destruction.
verses.15:4: And I will deliver them into distresses for all the kingdoms of the earth because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, concerning all that he did in Jerusalem.
verses.15:5: Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? And who will be dismayed over you? Or who will turn back for your peace?
verses.15:6: You turned away from Me, says the Lord; you will go backward. And I will stretch out My hand and destroy you, and I will no longer spare them.
verses.15:7: And I will scatter them in dispersion; in the gates of My people they were made childless; they destroyed My people because of their evils.
verses.15:8: Their widows were multiplied beyond the sand of the sea; they brought upon a mother young men, misery at midday; they cast upon her suddenly trembling and haste.
verses.15:9: She who bears seven was emptied; her soul grew faint; the sun went down for her while the day was still at midday; she was put to shame and disgraced; the rest of them I will give to the sword before their enemies.'"
verses.15:10: Woe is me, mother! As what did you bear me? A man disputing and contending in all the land! I neither gave benefit, nor did anyone benefit me; my strength failed among those who curse me.
verses.15:11: May it be so, Master, while they prosper, if I did not stand before You in the time of their calamities and in the time of their affliction, for good against the enemy.
verses.15:12: Will iron be known? And a bronze covering is your strength.
verses.15:13: And your treasures I will give for plunder, as an exchange because of all your sins and in all your borders.
verses.15:14: And I will enslave you all around to your enemies in the land that you did not know; for a fire has been kindled from My wrath; upon you it will burn.
verses.15:15: Lord, remember me and visit me, and acquit me from those who pursue me, not in forbearance; know that I received reproach on Your account
verses.15:16: from those who reject Your words; bring an end to them, and Your word will be to me for gladness and joy of my heart, because Your name has been called upon me, Lord Almighty.
verses.15:17: I did not sit in their assembly as they made merry, but I stood in awe before the presence of Your hand; I sat alone, because I was filled with bitterness.
verses.15:18: Why do those who grieve me prevail over me? My wound is severe; from where will I be healed? Indeed it has become to me like deceitful water, having no reliability.
verses.15:19: Therefore, thus says the Lord: "If you turn back, then I will restore you, and you will stand before My face; and if you bring out what is precious from what is worthy, you will be like My mouth; and they will turn back to you, and you will not turn back to them.
verses.15:20: And I will make you to this people like a fortified bronze wall; and they will fight against you, and they will certainly not prevail against you, because I am with you to save you
verses.15:21: and to rescue you from the hand of evil ones, and I will redeem you from the hand of pestilent ones."
verses.16:1: "And you, do not take a wife," says the Lord God of Israel,
verses.16:2: "and no son nor daughter will be born to you in this place."
verses.16:3: For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who have borne them, and concerning their fathers who have fathered them in this land:
verses.16:4: "By a diseased death they will die; they will not be lamented, and they will not be buried; they will be for an example on the face of the earth, and they will be for the wild beasts of the earth and for the birds of the sky; by the sword they will fall, and by famine they will be brought to an end."
verses.16:5: Thus says the Lord: "Do not enter their gathering, and do not go to lament, and do not mourn for them, because I have withdrawn My peace from this people.
verses.16:6: They will certainly not lament for them, nor will they make incisions, and they will not be shaved;
verses.16:7: and bread will certainly not be broken in their mourning for comfort over one who has died; they will not give him a cup to drink for comfort over his father and mother.
verses.16:8: Into a house of drinking you will not enter to sit down with them to eat and drink."
verses.16:9: For thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Look, I am abolishing from this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride."
verses.16:10: And it will be, when you declare to this people all these words, and they say to you, "Why has the Lord spoken against us all these calamities? What is our injustice? And what is our sin that we have sinned before the Lord our God?"
verses.16:11: then you will say to them, "Because your fathers forsook Me, says the Lord, and went off after foreign gods and served them and worshiped them, and forsook Me and did not keep My law,
verses.16:12: and you acted more wickedly than your fathers; and look, each of you walks after the pleasing things of your evil heart so as not to obey Me.
verses.16:13: And I will cast you away from this land into the land that you and your fathers did not know, and you will serve other gods there, who will not give you mercy."
verses.16:14: "Therefore, look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and they will no longer say, 'The Lord lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt,'
verses.16:15: but, 'The Lord lives, who brought up the house of Israel from the land of the north and from all the countries where they were driven out.' And I will restore them to their land that I gave to their fathers.
verses.16:16: Look, I am sending the many fishermen," says the Lord, "and they will fish for them; and after these things I will send the many hunters, and they will hunt them upon every mountain and upon every hill and out of the crevices of the rocks.
verses.16:17: For My eyes are upon all their ways, and their unjust deeds were not hidden before My eyes.
verses.16:18: And I will repay because of all their evils and their sins, by which they profaned My land with the carcasses of their abominations and with their lawless deeds, by which they trespassed against My inheritance."
verses.16:19: Lord, You are my strength and my help and my refuge in days of calamities; to You nations will come from the end of the earth and say, "How false are the idols our fathers acquired, and there is no benefit in them!
verses.16:20: Will a man make gods for himself, when these are not gods?"
verses.16:21: Therefore, look, I will reveal to them at this time My hand, and I will make known to them My power, and they will know that My name is the Lord.
verses.17:5: Cursed is the man who has his hope in man, and rests the flesh of his arm upon him, and his heart turns away from the Lord;
verses.17:6: and he will be like the wild tamarisk in the wilderness; he will not see when good things come, and he will dwell in salt flats and in a wilderness, in a salty land that is not inhabited.
verses.17:7: And blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, and the Lord will be his hope;
verses.17:8: and he will be like a thriving tree beside waters, and toward moisture it will cast its root; it will not fear when heat comes, and upon it there will be leafy branches; in a year of drought it will not fear, and it will not cease bearing fruit.
verses.17:9: Deep is the heart beyond all things, and it is a man; and who will know him?
verses.17:10: I am the Lord, examining hearts and testing kidneys, to give to each one according to his ways and according to the fruits of his practices.
verses.17:11: A partridge cried out; it gathered what it did not bear. One making his wealth not with justice—in the middle of his days they will forsake him, and at his end he will be foolish.
verses.17:12: An exalted throne of glory is our sanctuary.
verses.17:13: Hope of Israel, Lord, let all who forsake You be put to shame; let those who have departed be written on the earth, because they have forsaken the spring of life, the Lord.
verses.17:14: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, because You are my boast.
verses.17:15: Look, they say to me, "Where is the word of the Lord? Let it come!"
verses.17:16: But I did not grow weary following behind You, and the day of man I did not desire, You know; the things going out through my lips are before Your face.
verses.17:17: Do not become an alienation to me, You who spare me in an evil day.
verses.17:18: Let those who pursue me be put to shame, and may I not be put to shame; may they be terrified, and may I not be terrified; bring upon them an evil day; with a double shattering, shatter them.
verses.17:19: Thus says the Lord: "Go and stand in the gates of the sons of your people, through which kings of Judah enter and through which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem,
verses.17:20: and you will say to them the word of the Lord: 'Kings of Judah and all Judea and all Jerusalem, who enter through these gates,
verses.17:21: thus says the Lord: Guard your souls, and do not carry burdens on the Sabbath day, and do not go out through the gates of Jerusalem,
verses.17:22: and do not bring out burdens from your houses on the Sabbath day, and you shall not do any work; sanctify the Sabbath day, just as I commanded your fathers. And they did not listen and did not incline their ear,
verses.17:23: and they stiffened their neck more than their fathers so as not to listen to Me and not to receive discipline.
verses.17:24: And it will be, if you heed Me, says the Lord, so as not to bring in burdens through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and to sanctify the Sabbath day so as not to do any work,
verses.17:25: then kings and rulers will enter through the gates of this city, sitting on the throne of David and mounted on their chariots and horses, they and their rulers, men of Judah and those who dwell in Jerusalem; and this city will be inhabited forever;
verses.17:26: and they will come from the cities of Judah, and from around Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the lowland, and from the mountain, and from the land toward the south, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifice and incenses and manna and frankincense, bringing praise into the house of the Lord.
verses.17:27: And it will be, if you do not heed Me to sanctify the Sabbath day, not to carry burdens and not to enter through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the streets of Jerusalem, and it will not be quenched.'"
verses.18:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.18:2: "Rise up and go down to the potter's house, and there you will hear My words."
verses.18:3: And I went down to the potter's house, and look, he was doing work on the stones.
verses.18:4: And the vessel that he was making fell in his hands; and again he made it into another vessel, just as it was pleasing before him to make.
verses.18:5: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.18:6: "Just as this potter does, will I not be able to do with you, house of Israel? Look, like the potter's clay, you are in My hands.
verses.18:7: In the end I will speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom, to remove them and to destroy,
verses.18:8: and should that nation turn from all their evils, I will change My mind concerning the evils that I planned to do to them.
verses.18:9: And in the end I will speak concerning a nation and a kingdom, to be rebuilt and to be planted,
verses.18:10: and should they do wicked things before Me, so as not to listen to My voice, I will change My mind concerning the good things that I spoke of doing for them.
verses.18:11: And now speak to the men of Judah and to those who dwell in Jerusalem: 'Look, I am forming evils against you, and I am devising a plan against you. Let each one turn back now from his wicked way, and you will make your practices better.'"
verses.18:12: And they said, "We will act courageously, for we will walk after our turnings away, and each of us will do the pleasing things of his wicked heart."
verses.18:13: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Ask now among the nations, 'Who has heard such horrifying things as virgin Israel has exceedingly done?'
verses.18:14: Will breasts fail from a rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water carried violently by the wind turn aside?
verses.18:15: For My people have forgotten Me; they have burned incense in vain, and they will grow weak in their ways—eternal cords—so as to tread paths that have no road for travel,
verses.18:16: to set their land for desolation and an eternal hissing; all who pass through it will be astounded and will shake their heads.
verses.18:17: Like a scorching wind I will scatter them before the face of their enemies; I will show them the day of their destruction."
verses.18:18: And they said, "Come, let us devise a plan against Jeremiah, for law will not perish from a priest, nor counsel from a discerning man, nor a word from a prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and we will listen to all his words."
verses.18:19: Listen to me, Lord, and listen to the voice of my just cause.
verses.18:20: Is evil repaid for good? For they have spoken words together against my life, and they have hidden their punishment for me. Remember my standing before Your face to speak good things on their behalf, to turn away Your wrath from them.
verses.18:21: Therefore give their sons over to famine, and gather them into the hands of the sword; let their wives become childless and widows, and let their husbands become killed by death, and their young men fallen by the sword in war.
verses.18:22: Let an outcry arise in their houses; You will bring raiders upon them suddenly, because they took up a word for my capture and hid snares against me.
verses.18:23: And You, Lord, know all their counsel against me for death; do not acquit their injustices, and do not blot out their sins from before Your face. Let their weakness be before You; in the time of Your wrath, deal with them.
verses.19:1: Then the Lord said to me, "Go and acquire a formed earthenware jar, and you will take some of the elders of the people and some of the priests,
verses.19:2: and you will go out to the burial ground of the sons of their children, which is at the entrance of the Tharsis Gate, and read aloud there all these words that I will speak to you,
verses.19:3: and you will say to them, 'Hear the word of the Lord, kings of Judah and men of Judah and those who dwell in Jerusalem and those who enter through these gates. Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Look, I am bringing evils upon this place, so that the ears of everyone who hears them will ring,
verses.19:4: because they have forsaken Me and alienated this place, and burned incense in it to foreign gods whom they and their fathers did not know; and the kings of Judah filled this place with innocent blood,
verses.19:5: and built high places to Baal to burn up their sons in fire; I did not command it, nor did I consider it in My heart.
verses.19:6: Therefore, look, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will not be called Collapse and Burial Ground of the son of Hinnom, but rather Burial Ground of the Slaughter.
verses.19:7: And I will slaughter the counsel of Judah and the counsel of Jerusalem in this place, and I will cast them down by the sword before their enemies and by the hands of those who seek their lives, and I will give their dead bodies as food to the birds of the sky and to the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.19:8: And I will bring this city down to desolation and to hissing; everyone who passes by it will look gloomy and will hiss over its entire plague.
verses.19:9: And they will eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each one will eat the flesh of his neighbor in the encirclement and siege with which their enemies will besiege them.'
verses.19:10: And you will shatter the jar before the eyes of the men who go out with you,
verses.19:11: and you will say, 'Thus says the Lord: In this way I will shatter this people and this city, just as an earthenware vessel is shattered, which will not be able to be healed.
verses.19:12: For in this way I will do, says the Lord, to this place and to those who dwell in it, so that this city is made like the collapsing one.
verses.19:13: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be just like the collapsing place, because of their impurities, in all the houses in which they burned incense on their rooftops to all the host of heaven and poured out drink offerings to foreign gods.'"
verses.19:14: And Jeremiah came from the Collapse, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, and stood in the court of the house of the Lord and said to all the people:
verses.19:15: "Thus says the Lord: Look, I am bringing upon this city and upon all its cities and upon its villages all the evils that I spoke against it, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to listen to My commands."
verses.20:1: And Pashhur son of Immer, the priest—and he was appointed leader of the house of the Lord—heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
verses.20:2: And he struck him and threw him into the dungeon that was in the gate of the upper house set apart, which was in the house of the Lord.
verses.20:3: And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the dungeon, and Jeremiah said to him, "The Lord has not called your name Pashhur, but rather Exile.
verses.20:4: For thus says the Lord: 'Look, I am giving you over to exile along with all your friends; and they will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it; and I will give you and all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, and they will exile them and cut them down with swords.
verses.20:5: And I will give all the strength of this city and all its labors and all the treasures of the king of Judah into the hands of his enemies, and they will bring them to Babylon.
verses.20:6: And you and all who dwell in your house will go in captivity, and in Babylon you will die, and there you will be buried, you and all your friends to whom you prophesied falsehoods.'"
verses.20:7: You deceived me, Lord, and I was deceived; You were strong and prevailed. I became an object of laughter; all day long I continued being mocked;
verses.20:8: for with my bitter word I will laugh; I will call out treachery and misery, because the word of the Lord has become a reproach to me and a derision every day of mine.
verses.20:9: And I said, "I will certainly not name the name of the Lord, and I will no longer speak in His name." And it became like a burning fire blazing in my bones, and I am weakened on every side and cannot bear it,
verses.20:10: for I heard the censure of many gathering together all around, all around: "Band together, and let us band together against him, all you men who are his friends! Watch his intention, whether he will be deceived, and we will prevail against him and take our vengeance on him."
verses.20:11: But the Lord is with me like a strong warrior; therefore they pursued and were unable to understand. They were utterly put to shame, because they did not understand their disgraces, which will not be forgotten forever.
verses.20:12: Lord, testing righteous things, understanding kidneys and hearts, may I see the vengeance from You upon them, for to You I have uncovered my defenses.
verses.20:13: Sing to the Lord, praise Him, for He has delivered the soul of a poor person from the hand of evildoers.
verses.20:14: Cursed be the day on which I was born. Let the day on which my mother gave birth to me not be desired;
verses.20:15: cursed be the man who brought good news to my father, saying, "A male child has been born to you," rejoicing.
verses.20:16: Let that man be like the cities that the Lord overthrew in fury and did not relent; let him hear an outcry in the morning and a battle cry at noon,
verses.20:17: because he did not kill me in the womb, and my mother would have become my grave for me, and her womb of eternal conception.
