verses.20:18: Why is it that I came out of the womb to see toils and pains, and my days have ended in shame?
verses.21:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchijah and Zephaniah son of Manassaeus, the priest, saying,
verses.21:2: "Inquire of the Lord on our behalf, because the king of Babylon has come against us, whether the Lord will act according to all His wonders, and he will depart from us."
verses.21:3: And Jeremiah said to them, "Thus you shall say to Zedekiah king of Judah,
verses.21:4: 'Thus says the Lord: Look, I am turning back the weapons of war with which you are fighting against the Chaldeans who have shut you in outside the wall, into the midst of this city,
verses.21:5: and I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a mighty arm, with fury and great wrath;
verses.21:6: and I will strike all those who dwell in this city, the people and the livestock, with a great death, and they will die.
verses.21:7: And after these things, thus says the Lord: I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and the people who are left in this city from death and from famine and from the sword into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives, and they will cut them down with the edge of the sword; I will not spare them, and I will by no means have compassion on them.'"
verses.21:8: And to this people you shall say, "Thus says the Lord: Look, I have set before your face the way of life and the way of death:
verses.21:9: The one who remains in this city will die by the sword and by famine, and the one who goes out to surrender to the Chaldeans who have shut you in will live, and his life will be as plunder, and he will live.
verses.21:10: For I have firmly set My face against this city for evil and not for good; it will be handed over into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it up with fire."
verses.21:11: House of the king of Judah, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.21:12: House of David, thus says the Lord: "Render judgment in the morning and direct it rightly, and rescue the one who has been plundered from the hand of the one who wrongs him, so that My wrath may not be kindled like fire and burn, and there be no one who will extinguish it.
verses.21:13: Look, I am against you who dwell in the level valley of Sor, those who say, 'Who will terrify us? Or who will enter into the dwelling place?'
verses.21:14: And I will kindle a fire in its forest, and it will devour all things around it."
verses.22:1: Thus says the Lord: "Go and go down to the house of the king of Judah, and you shall speak this word there,
verses.22:2: and you shall say, 'Hear the word of the Lord, king of Judah who sits on the throne of David, you and your house and your people and those who enter by these gates:
verses.22:3: Thus says the Lord: Do justice and righteousness, and rescue the one who has been plundered from the hand of the one who wrongs him, and do not oppress the resident alien and the orphan and the widow, and do not act impiously, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.22:4: For if you indeed do this word, then there will enter through the gates of this house kings sitting on the throne of David and riding on chariots and horses, they and their servants and their people.
verses.22:5: But if you do not do these words, I have sworn by Myself, says the Lord, that this house will become a desolation.'"
verses.22:6: For thus says the Lord against the house of the king of Judah: "You are Gilead to Me, the summit of Lebanon; surely I will make you into a wilderness, cities that will not be inhabited;
verses.22:7: and I will bring upon you a destroying man and his axe, and they will cut down your choice cedars and throw them into the fire.
verses.22:8: And nations will pass through this city, and each one will say to his neighbor, 'Why has the Lord done thus to this great city?'
verses.22:9: And they will say, 'Because they forsook the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshiped foreign gods and served them.'"
verses.22:10: Do not weep for the one who has died, nor lament him; weep bitterly for the one who goes away, because he is not returning again, nor will he see the land of his native country.
verses.22:11: For thus says the Lord concerning Shallum son of Josiah, who reigned in place of Josiah his father, who went out from this place: "He will not return there again,
verses.22:12: but in the place where I led him into exile, there he will die, and this land he will not see again."
verses.22:13: The one who builds his house not with righteousness and his upper rooms not with justice will work with his neighbor for nothing, and will by no means pay him his wages.
verses.22:14: You have built for yourself a well-proportioned house, airy upper rooms pierced with windows and paneled in cedar and painted with vermilion.
verses.22:15: Will you reign, because you are provoked against Ahaz your father? They will not eat and they will not drink; it is better for you to do justice and righteousness.
verses.22:16: They did not know; they did not judge the cause of the humble nor the cause of the poor. Is this not your not knowing Me, says the Lord?
verses.22:17: Look, your eyes and your heart are not good, but are on your greed, and on innocent blood to shed it, and on wrongdoing and on murder to do them.
verses.22:18: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: "And for this man they will by no means mourn him, 'Ah, brother!' nor will they weep for him, 'Alas, lord!'
verses.22:19: With the burial of a donkey he will be buried; swept away, he will be thrown beyond the gate of Jerusalem."
verses.22:20: Go up to Lebanon and cry out, and in Bashan lift up your voice, and shout to the far side of the sea, because all your lovers have been crushed.
verses.22:21: I spoke to you in your transgression, and you said, "I will not listen." This has been your way from your youth; you have not listened to My voice.
verses.22:22: The wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go out in captivity, for then you will be ashamed and dishonored because of all those who love you.
verses.22:23: You who dwell in Lebanon, who nest in the cedars, you will groan deeply when pains come upon you like those of a woman giving birth.
verses.22:24: "As I live," says the Lord, "even if Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were indeed a signet ring on My right hand, from there I will tear you off,
verses.22:25: and I will hand you over into the hands of those who seek your life, whose face you dread, into the hands of the Chaldeans.
verses.22:26: And I will hurl you and your mother who bore you into a land where you were not born, and there you will die;
verses.22:27: but to the land for which they pray in their souls they will by no means return."
verses.22:28: Jeconiah has been dishonored like a vessel for which there is no use, because he has been cast out and thrown into a land that he did not know.
verses.22:29: Land, land, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.22:30: "Write this man down as an outcast man, because no one from his seed will flourish sitting on the throne of David, ruling any longer in Judah."
verses.23:1: Ah, shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of their pasture!
verses.23:2: Therefore, thus says the Lord against those who shepherd My people: "You have scattered My sheep and driven them out and have not attended to them; look, I am bringing punishment upon you according to your evil practices.
verses.23:3: And I Myself will gather in the remnant of My people from all over the earth where I drove them out, and I will restore them to their pasture, and they will increase and multiply.
verses.23:4: And I will raise up for them shepherds who will shepherd them, and they will no longer be afraid nor terrified," says the Lord.
verses.23:5: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "and I will raise up for David a righteous shoot, and a king will reign and have understanding and practice justice and righteousness on the earth.
verses.23:6: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell in confidence; and this is his name which the Lord will call him: Josedek." Concerning the prophets.
verses.23:9: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I have become like a broken man and like a man overcome by wine, because of the Lord and because of the splendor of His glory.
verses.23:10: For because of these things the land mourned, the pastures of the wilderness dried up, and their forest became evil, and their strength likewise.
verses.23:11: "For priest and prophet have been defiled, and in My house I saw their evil deeds.
verses.23:12: Therefore, let their way become for them a slippery place in thick darkness, and they will be tripped up and fall in it; because I will bring evil upon them in the year of their visitation.
verses.23:13: And among the prophets of Samaria I saw lawless deeds: they prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.
verses.23:14: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen horrifying things: committing adultery, and walking in lies, and taking hold of the hands of many so that no one turns back from his evil way; they have all become to Me like Sodom, and those who dwell in her like Gomorrah."
verses.23:15: Therefore, thus says the Lord: "Look, I will feed them pain and give them bitter water to drink, because from the prophets of Jerusalem defilement has gone out to all the land."
verses.23:16: Thus says the Lord Almighty: "Do not listen to the words of the prophets, because they make a vain vision for themselves; they speak from their own heart and not from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.23:17: They say to those who reject the word of the Lord, 'There will be peace for you,' and to all who walk in their own desires—to everyone who walks in the deception of his heart they have said, 'Evil will not come upon you.'
verses.23:18: For who has stood in the council of the Lord and seen His word? Who has given ear and heard?
verses.23:19: Look, a tempest from the Lord! And wrath goes out into a whirlwind; whirling around, it will come upon the ungodly,
verses.23:20: and the fury of the Lord will no longer turn back until He carries it out from the design of His heart; at the end of the days they will understand it.
verses.23:21: I did not send the prophets, yet they ran; nor did I speak to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.23:22: And if they had stood in My council and if they had listened to My words, then they would have turned My people back from their evil practices.
verses.23:23: I am a God who draws near, and not a God from afar.
verses.23:24: If someone hides in secret places, will I not see him? Do I not fill heaven and earth?" says the Lord.
verses.23:25: "I have heard what the prophets are saying; they prophesy falsehoods in My name, saying, 'I have dreamed a dream.'
verses.23:26: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy falsehoods, as they prophesy the desires of their own heart,
verses.23:27: who plan to forget My law by their dreams which they recounted, each one to his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name because of Baal?
verses.23:28: Let the prophet in whom the dream is recount his dream, and let the one in whom My word is recount My word in truth. What is the chaff to the wheat?
verses.23:29: So are My words," says the Lord. "Look, are not My words like fire, and like an axe cutting rock?"
verses.23:30: "Look, therefore I am against the prophets," says the Lord God, "who steal My words, each one from his neighbor.
verses.23:31: Look, I am against the prophets who put forth prophecies of the tongue and slumber their slumber.
verses.23:32: Therefore, look, I am against the prophets who prophesy false dreams, and did not recount them, and led My people astray by their lies and by their deceptions; yet I did not send them and I did not command them, and they will not benefit this people at all."
verses.23:33: "And if this people, or a priest, or a prophet asks you, 'What is the burden of the Lord?' then you will say to them, 'You are the burden, and I will dash you down,'" says the Lord.
verses.23:34: "As for the prophet and the priests and the people who say, 'The burden of the Lord,' I will punish that man and his house.
verses.23:35: Thus you will say, each one to his neighbor and each one to his brother: 'What has the Lord answered, and what has the Lord spoken?'
verses.23:36: And do not mention 'The burden of the Lord' any longer, because the burden for a man will be his own word."
verses.23:37: And why has the Lord our God spoken?
verses.23:38: Therefore, thus says the Lord our God: "Because you spoke this word, 'The burden of the Lord,' though I sent to you, saying, 'You must not say, "The burden of the Lord,"'
verses.23:39: therefore, look, I am taking you up and dashing you down, and the city that I gave to you and to your fathers,
verses.23:40: and I will put upon you everlasting reproach and everlasting disgrace, which will not be forgotten. Therefore, look, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, 'The Lord lives, who brought up the house of Israel out of the land of Egypt,' but, 'The Lord lives, who gathered all the seed of Israel from the land of the north and from all the countries where He drove them out, and restored them to their land.'"
verses.24:1: The Lord showed me two baskets of figs set before the temple of the Lord, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had exiled Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the officials and the craftsmen and the prisoners and the neighbors from Jerusalem, and brought them to Babylon.
verses.24:2: One basket had very good figs, like the early figs, and the other basket had very bad figs, which cannot be eaten because of their badness.
verses.24:3: And the Lord said to me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "Figs: the good ones, very good, and the bad ones, very bad, which cannot be eaten because of their badness."
verses.24:4: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.24:5: "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Like these good figs, so I will regard the exiled Judeans, whom I have sent away from this place into the land of the Chaldeans, for good.
verses.24:6: And I will fix My eyes upon them for good, and I will restore them to this land for good; and I will build them up and will by no means tear them down, and I will plant them and will by no means uproot them.
verses.24:7: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord; and they will be a people to Me, and I will be God to them, because they will turn back to Me with their whole heart;
verses.24:8: and like the bad figs that cannot be eaten because of their badness—thus says the Lord—so I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah and his nobles and the remnant of Jerusalem, those who are left behind in this land and those who dwell in Egypt.
verses.24:9: And I will give them over to scattering among all the kingdoms of the earth, and to reproach and a byword and hatred and a curse in every place where I drove them out;
verses.24:10: and I will send against them famine and death and the sword, until they vanish from the land that I gave to them."
verses.25:1: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah,
verses.25:2: which he spoke to all the people of Judah and to those who dwell in Jerusalem, saying:
verses.25:3: "In the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amos, king of Judah, and until this day—twenty-three years—I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking.
verses.25:4: And I sent to you My servants the prophets, sending early in the morning, yet you did not listen and did not pay attention with your ears,
verses.25:5: saying, 'Turn back, each one from his evil way and from your evil practices, and you will dwell on the land that I gave to you and to your fathers from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.25:6: Do not go after foreign gods to serve them and to worship them, so that you do not provoke Me to anger by the works of your hands, to bring harm upon you.'
verses.25:7: Yet you did not listen to Me.
verses.25:8: Therefore, thus says the Lord: 'Because you did not believe My words,
verses.25:9: look, I am sending and will take a clan from the north, and I will bring them against this land and against those who dwell in it and against all the nations around it; and I will make them desolate and give them over to ruin and to hissing and to everlasting reproach.
verses.25:10: And I will abolish from them the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the scent of perfume and the light of a lamp.
verses.25:11: And all the land will become a ruin, and they will serve among the nations seventy years,
verses.25:12: and when seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish that nation and I will make them an everlasting ruin,
verses.25:13: and I will bring upon that land all My words that I have spoken against it, all the things written in this book.'"
verses.25:14: What Jeremiah prophesied against the nations of Elam.
verses.25:15: Thus says the Lord: "The bow of Elam is broken, the chief of their might.
verses.25:16: And I will bring upon Elam four winds from the four ends of heaven, and I will scatter them among all these winds; and there will be no nation to which those driven out of Elam will not come.
verses.25:17: And I will terrify them before their enemies who seek their life; and I will bring it upon them according to the wrath of My fury, and I will send My sword after them until I completely consume them.
verses.25:18: And I will set My throne in Elam, and I will send away from there king and nobles;
verses.25:19: and it will come about at the end of the days that I will bring back the captivity of Elam," says the Lord.
verses.26:2: For Egypt: against the army of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, who was at the Euphrates River in Carchemish, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim king of Judah.
verses.26:3: Take up weapons and shields, and advance to battle,
verses.26:4: and saddle the horses; mount up, horsemen, and take your stand in your helmets; thrust forward the spears and put on your breastplates.
verses.26:5: Why is it that they are terrified and withdraw backward? Because their mighty ones will be cut down; in flight they fled and did not turn back, surrounded on every side, says the Lord.
verses.26:6: Let not the swift flee, and let not the mighty one escape to the north; those beside the Euphrates grew weak, and they have fallen.
verses.26:7: Who is this who will rise up like a river, and like rivers that surge with water?
verses.26:8: The waters of Egypt will rise up like a river, and it said, "I will rise up and cover the earth and destroy those who dwell in it."
verses.26:9: Mount the horses, prepare the chariots; go out, warriors of the Ethiopians, and Libyans armed with weapons, and Lydians, go up, draw the bow,
verses.26:10: and that day belongs to the Lord our God, a day of vengeance, to take vengeance on His enemies; and the sword of the Lord will devour, and it will be filled and become drunk from their blood; for the Lord has a sacrifice from the land of the north at the Euphrates River.
verses.26:11: Go up, Gilead, and take resin for the virgin daughter of Egypt; in vain you have multiplied your remedies; there is no benefit for you.
verses.26:12: Nations heard your voice, and the earth was filled with your outcry, because warrior grew weak against warrior; together both of them fell.
verses.26:13: The things that the Lord spoke by the hand of Jeremiah, that the king of Babylon would come to strike down the land of Egypt.
verses.26:14: Announce in Migdol, and proclaim in Memphis; say, "Take your stand and prepare, for a sword has devoured your bindweed."
verses.26:15: Why did Apis flee from you? Your choice calf did not remain, because the Lord enfeebled him.
verses.26:16: And your multitude grew weak and they fell, and each one spoke to his neighbor, "Let us rise and return to our people, to our homeland, from the face of the Greek sword."
verses.26:17: Call the name of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt "Saon Esbei Emoed."
verses.26:18: As I live, says the Lord God, surely like Tabor among the mountains and like Carmel that is by the sea, he will come.
verses.26:19: Make for yourself baggage for exile, inhabitant, daughter of Egypt; for Memphis will become a desolation, and it will be called "Woe," because there are no inhabitants in it.
verses.26:20: Egypt is a beautified heifer; a detachment from the north has come upon her,
verses.26:21: and her mercenaries within her are like fattened calves nourished in her; for they also turned away and fled with one accord; they did not stand, because the day of destruction came upon them, and the time of their vengeance.
verses.26:22: A sound like a hissing serpent, for they march in sand; with axes they will come against her,
verses.26:23: like those cutting wood they will cut down her forest, says the Lord, for it cannot be estimated, because it is more numerous than locusts, and there is no number to them.
verses.26:24: The daughter of Egypt has been put to shame; she has been delivered into the hands of a people from the north.
verses.26:25: Look, I am taking vengeance on Amon her son, upon Pharaoh and upon those who trust in him.
verses.26:27: But you, do not fear, My servant Jacob, nor be terrified, Israel; for look, I am saving you from far away, and your seed from their captivity; and Jacob will return and be at rest and sleep, and there will be no one troubling him.
verses.26:28: Do not fear, My servant Jacob, says the Lord, for I am with you; the fearless and delicate one has been delivered up; for I will make a complete end among all to whom I drove you out there, but as for you, I will by no means cause you to fail; and I will discipline you with judgment, and I will not acquit you as innocent.
verses.27:1: The word of the Lord which He spoke against Babylon.
verses.27:2: Announce among the nations and make it heard, and do not conceal it; say, "Babylon has been captured; Bel, the fearless one, has been put to shame; the delicate one, Merodach, has been delivered up."
verses.27:3: For a nation from the north has come up against her; this one will make her land a desolation, and there will be no one dwelling in it, from man even to beast.
verses.27:4: In those days and at that time, the sons of Israel will come, they and the sons of Judah together; walking and weeping they will go, seeking the Lord their God.
verses.27:5: They will ask the way to Zion, for here they will set their face, and they will come and take refuge with the Lord God; for an everlasting covenant will not be forgotten.
verses.27:6: My people have become lost sheep; their shepherds drove them out, upon the mountains they led them astray; from mountain to hill they went; they forgot their resting place.
verses.27:7: All who found them consumed them; their enemies said, "Let us not spare them, because they sinned against the Lord; a pasture of righteousness belongs to the One who gathered their fathers."
verses.27:8: Estrange yourselves from the midst of Babylon and from the land of the Chaldeans and go out, and become like dragons before sheep.
verses.27:9: For look, I am raising up against Babylon assemblies of nations from the land of the north, and they will draw up in battle array against her; from there she will be captured; like the dart of a skilled warrior, it will not return empty.
verses.27:10: And Chaldea will become plunder; all who plunder her will be filled.
verses.27:11: Because you rejoiced and boasted while pillaging My inheritance, because you leaped like calves in the grass and butted like bulls.
verses.27:12: Your mother has been put to shame greatly, a mother for good things, the last of the nations, a wilderness,
verses.27:13: because of the wrath of the Lord she will not be inhabited; and all of her will become a desolation, and everyone passing through Babylon will look grim, and they will hiss over all her wound.
verses.27:14: Draw up in battle array against Babylon all around, all you who draw a bow; shoot at her, do not spare your arrows,
verses.27:15: and overpower her; her hands have been enfeebled, her battlements have fallen, and her wall has been demolished; for it is vengeance from God; take vengeance on her, just as she has done, do to her.
verses.27:16: Utterly destroy seed from Babylon, the one holding a sickle in the time of harvest; from the face of the Greek sword each one will turn back to his people, and each one will flee to his land.
verses.27:17: Israel is a straying sheep; lions drove him out; the first one devoured him, the king of Assyria, and afterward this one his bones, the king of Babylon.
verses.27:18: Therefore, thus says the Lord: "Look, I am taking vengeance on the one of Babylon and on his land, just as I took vengeance on the king of Assyria.
verses.27:19: And I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and on Mount Ephraim and in Gilead, and his soul will be filled.
verses.27:20: In those days and at that time, they will seek the unrighteousness of Israel, and it will not exist, and the sins of Judah, and they will by no means be found, because I will be merciful to those left behind on the earth," says the Lord.
verses.27:21: Bitterly advance against her and against those who dwell upon her; take vengeance, sword, and make desolate, says the Lord, and do according to all that I command you.
verses.27:22: A sound of war and great shattering in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.27:23: How has the hammer of all the earth been broken and shattered? How has Babylon become a desolation among the nations?
verses.27:24: They will advance against you, and you will not know, like Babylon, and you will be captured; you were found and you were taken, because you resisted the Lord.
verses.27:25: The Lord has opened His treasury and brought out the instruments of His wrath, for the Lord God has a work in the land of the Chaldeans,
verses.27:26: because her times have come. Open her storehouses, search her like a cave and utterly destroy her; let there be no remnant of her.
verses.27:27: Dry up all her fruits, and let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come and the time of their vengeance.
verses.27:28: A sound of those fleeing and escaping from the land of Babylon, to announce in Zion the vengeance from the Lord our God.
verses.27:29: Summon many against Babylon, everyone who draws a bow; encamp against her on every side; let there be no one escaping from her; repay her according to her works; according to all that she has done, do to her, because she resisted the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
verses.27:30: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all her men of war will be cast down, said the Lord.
verses.27:31: Look, I am against you, you arrogant one, says the Lord, for your day has come and the time of your vengeance,
verses.27:32: and your arrogance will grow weak and fall, and there will be no one raising it up; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all that is around her.
verses.27:33: Thus says the Lord: "The sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have been oppressed; together all those who took them captive oppressed them, because they were not willing to send them away.
verses.27:34: And the One who redeems them is mighty; the Lord Almighty is His name; He will render judgment against His adversaries, so that He may remove the earth, and He will provoke those who dwell in Babylon.
verses.27:35: A sword against the Chaldeans and against those who dwell in Babylon, and against her nobles and against her discerning ones;
verses.27:36: a sword against her warriors, and they will be enfeebled; a sword against their horses and against their chariots;
verses.27:37: a sword against their warriors and against the mixed crowd that is in her midst, and they will become like women; a sword against her treasuries, and they will be scattered
verses.27:38: upon her water, and they will be put to shame, for it is a land of carved images, and in the islands where they boasted.
verses.27:39: Therefore apparitions will dwell in the islands, and daughters of sirens will dwell in her; she will by no means be inhabited again forever.
verses.27:40: Just as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring cities," said the Lord, "no man will dwell there, and no son of man will sojourn there."
verses.27:41: Look, a people is coming from the north, and a great nation and many kings will be roused from the end of the earth,
verses.27:42: holding bow and dagger; it is ruthless and will by no means show mercy; their voice will roar like the sea; upon horses they will ride, prepared like fire for war, against you, daughter of Babylon.
verses.27:43: The king of Babylon heard the report about them, and his hands were enfeebled; distress overpowered him, birth pangs like those of a woman giving birth.
verses.27:44: Look, like a lion he will come up from the Jordan to Gaithan, for swiftly I will drive them away from her, and every young man I will set over her. For who is like Me? And who will resist Me? And who is this shepherd who will stand before Me?
verses.27:45: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord which He has planned against Babylon, and His designs which He has devised against the Chaldean inhabitants: surely the lambs of their sheep will be destroyed, surely pasture will be made desolate from them.
verses.27:46: For at the sound of the capture of Babylon the earth will shake, and an outcry will be heard among the nations.
verses.28:1: Thus says the Lord: "Look, I am raising up against Babylon and against the Chaldean inhabitants a scorching, destroying wind.
verses.28:2: And I will send out insolent men into Babylon, and they will treat her with insolence and ravage her land; woe upon Babylon all around in the day of her affliction.
verses.28:3: Let the one who draws his bow draw it, and let the one who has his armor put it on; and do not spare her young men, and wipe out all her army.
verses.28:4: And wounded men will fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and those pierced through outside her."
verses.28:5: For Israel and Judah have not been widowed from their God, from the Lord Almighty; for their land was filled with unrighteousness from the holy things of Israel.
verses.28:6: Flee from the midst of Babylon, and each of you save his own life, and do not be cast away in her unrighteousness, for it is the time of her vengeance from the Lord; He Himself is repaying a repayment to her.
verses.28:7: Babylon was a golden cup in the hand of the Lord, making all the earth drunk; nations drank from her wine; therefore they were shaken.
verses.28:8: And suddenly Babylon fell and was shattered. Lament for her; take resin for her destruction, if perhaps she will be healed.
verses.28:9: "We treated Babylon, and she was not healed; let us forsake her and let us go away, each to his own land, for her judgment has reached to heaven; it has risen up as far as the stars."
verses.28:10: "The Lord has brought forth His judgment; come, and let us declare in Zion the works of the Lord our God."
verses.28:11: Prepare the arrows, fill the quivers! The Lord has roused the spirit of the king of the Medes, for His wrath is against Babylon to destroy her utterly, for it is the vengeance of the Lord; it is the vengeance of His people.
verses.28:12: Upon the walls of Babylon raise a signal, set up quivers, raise up watches, prepare weapons, for He has undertaken it; and the Lord will do the things He spoke against those who dwell in Babylon,
verses.28:13: who encamp upon many waters and upon the abundance of her treasures; your end has come, truly into your inward parts.
verses.28:14: For the Lord has sworn by His arm: "I will fill you with men like locusts, and those who come down will cry out against you."
verses.28:15: Making the earth by His strength, preparing the inhabited world by His wisdom, by His understanding He stretched out heaven.
verses.28:16: At a voice He set a roar of water in heaven, and He brought up clouds from the end of the earth; He made flashes of lightning for rain, and He brought forth light out of His treasuries.
verses.28:17: Every man has been made futile, devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith has been put to shame because of his carved images, for they cast false things; there is no breath in them.
verses.28:18: They are futile things, mocked works; in the time of their visitation they will perish.
verses.28:19: Not such is Jacob's portion, for the One who formed all things, He Himself is his inheritance; the Lord is His name.
verses.28:20: "You scatter for Me weapons of war, and I will scatter nations in you, and I will remove kings from you.
verses.28:21: And I will scatter in you horse and its rider,
verses.28:22: and I will scatter in you chariots and their riders; and I will scatter in you young man and virgin, and I will scatter in you man and woman.
verses.28:23: And I will scatter in you shepherd and his flock, and I will scatter in you farmer and his farm, and I will scatter in you your governors and commanders.
verses.28:24: And I will repay Babylon and all the Chaldean inhabitants for all their evils that they did against Zion before your eyes," says the Lord.
verses.28:25: "Look, I am against you, destroyed mountain that destroys all the earth; and I will stretch out My hand against you and roll you down upon the rocks, and I will make you like a burned mountain,
verses.28:26: and they will never take from you a stone for a corner or a stone for a foundation, for you will be a desolation forever," says the Lord.
verses.28:27: "Raise a signal upon the earth, sound a trumpet among the nations, consecrate nations against her, give orders against her, raise kings from Me, and to the Ashkenazites; set up siege engines against her, bring up horses against her like a multitude of locusts.
verses.28:28: Bring up nations against her, the king of the Medes and of all the earth, his leaders and all his commanders."
verses.28:29: The earth shook and was in pain, because the purpose of the Lord rose up against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation and for it not to be inhabited.
verses.28:30: The warrior of Babylon has ceased from fighting; they will sit there in a stronghold; their might has been broken; they have become like women; her dwellings have been burned; her bars have been shattered.
verses.28:31: A runner will run to meet a runner, and a messenger to meet a messenger, to report to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured,
verses.28:32: from the end of his crossings they have been seized, and they have burned their pools with fire, and his men of war are going out.
verses.28:33: For thus says the Lord: "The houses of the king of Babylon will be threshed like a ripe threshing floor; yet a little while, and her harvest will come."
verses.28:34: "He devoured me, he divided me up, a thin darkness overtook me; Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon swallowed me up; like a dragon he filled his belly from my delicacies;
verses.28:35: my toils and my distresses drove me out into Babylon," she who dwells in Zion will say; "And my blood is upon the Chaldean inhabitants," Jerusalem will say.
verses.28:36: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Look, I will judge your adversary and execute your vengeance, and I will lay waste her sea and dry up her spring;
verses.28:37: and Babylon will become a desolation, and will not be inhabited.
verses.28:38: For together like lions they awoke, and like cubs of lions.
verses.28:39: In their heat I will give them a drink, and I will make them drunk so that they may fall into a stupor and sleep an eternal sleep, and they will never awake," says the Lord.
verses.28:40: And bring them down like lambs to slaughter, and like rams with young goats.
verses.28:41: How has the boast of all the earth been captured and hunted down? How has Babylon become a desolation among the nations?
verses.28:42: The sea has come up over Babylon with the roar of its waves, and she has been covered over.
verses.28:43: Her cities have become like a waterless and impassable land; not even one will dwell in it, nor will a son of man lodge in it.
verses.28:44: "And I will execute vengeance upon Babylon, and I will bring out from her mouth the things she swallowed, and the nations will never again be gathered to her,
verses.28:49: and in Babylon wounded men of all the earth will fall."
verses.28:50: You who are escaping from the land, go and do not stand still; you from afar, remember the Lord, and let Jerusalem come up upon your heart.
verses.28:51: "We have been put to shame, because we have heard our reproach; dishonor has covered our face; foreigners have entered into our holy places, into the house of the Lord."
verses.28:52: "Therefore, here are days," says the Lord, "and I will execute vengeance upon her carved images, and in all her land wounded men will fall.
verses.28:53: For though Babylon should ascend like heaven, and though she should fortify the walls with her strength, from Me those who utterly destroy her will come," says the Lord.
verses.28:54: A sound of an outcry in Babylon, and a great shattering in the land of the Chaldeans,
verses.28:55: for the Lord has utterly destroyed Babylon, and He has destroyed from her a great voice roaring like many waters; He has given her voice to destruction.
verses.28:56: For distress has come upon Babylon; her warriors have been captured; their bow is dismayed, for God is repaying them.
verses.28:57: "The Lord is repaying, and He will make drunk with drunkenness her governors and her wise men and her commanders," says the King; the Lord Almighty is His name.
verses.28:58: Thus says the Lord: "The wall of Babylon was made broad; it will surely be razed, and her high gates will be burned; and peoples will not labor in vain, and nations will fail in the beginning."
verses.28:59: The word that the Lord commanded Jeremiah the prophet to speak to Seraiah son of Neriah, son of Maaseiah, when he went from Zedekiah king of Judah to Babylon, in the fourth year of his reign; and Seraiah was ruler of gifts.
verses.28:60: And Jeremiah wrote all the evils that will come upon Babylon in a book, all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.28:61: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, "When you come to Babylon, you will see and read all these words,
verses.28:62: and you will say, 'Lord, Lord, You have spoken against this place to destroy it utterly and for there to be no inhabitants in it, from man to beast, for it will be a desolation forever.'
verses.28:63: And it will be, when you finish reading this book, you will tie a stone onto it and throw it into the midst of the Euphrates,
verses.28:64: and you will say, 'Thus Babylon will sink and will never rise from before the Chaldeans whom I am bringing upon her.'"
verses.29:1: Against the foreigners. Thus says the Lord:
verses.29:2: "Look, waters are rising from the north, and they will become an overflowing torrent, and it will overflow the land and its fullness, the city and those who dwell in it; and the people will cry out, and all who dwell in the land will wail
verses.29:3: at the sound of his rushing, at the hooves of his feet, and at the shaking of his chariots, the roar of his wheels. Fathers did not turn back for their sons because of the feebleness of their hands,
verses.29:4: on the day that is coming to destroy all the foreigners. And I will wipe out Tyre and Sidon and all who remain of their help, for the Lord will utterly destroy those who remain of the islands.
verses.29:5: Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon has been cast away, and those who remain of the Anakim."
verses.29:6: How long will you slash, sword of the Lord? How long will you not be quiet? Return to your sheath; rest and be lifted up.
verses.29:7: How can it be quiet, when the Lord has commanded it to rise up against Ashkelon and against the coastal regions, against those that remain?
verses.30:1: Concerning Idumea. Thus says the Lord: "There is no longer wisdom in Teman; counsel has perished from the discerning, their wisdom has vanished,
verses.30:2: their place has been deceived. Go deep to settle, you who dwell in Dedan, for he has done grievous things; I brought them upon him in the time when I called him to account.
verses.30:3: For grape gatherers have come who will not leave you a remnant; like thieves in the night they will put forth their hand.
verses.30:4: For I have stripped Esau; I have uncovered their hidden places, and they will by no means be able to hide. They have perished by the hand of his brother, My neighbor, and it is not possible
verses.30:5: to leave your orphan behind so that he may live; and I will live, and widows have trusted in Me."
verses.30:6: For thus said the Lord: "Those for whom there was no law to drink the cup have drunk it; and you will by no means be acquitted,
verses.30:7: for by Myself I have sworn," says the Lord, "that you will become an untrodden waste and a reproach and a curse in her midst, and all her cities will be desolate forever."
verses.30:8: I have heard a report from the Lord, and He has sent messengers to the nations: "Gather together and come against her; rise up for war."
verses.30:9: "I have made you small among the nations, despised among people.
verses.30:10: Your playfulness has set upon you; the audacity of your heart has lodged in the clefts of the rocks and has seized the stronghold of a high hill. Because he has raised his nest high like an eagle, from there I will bring you down.
verses.30:11: And Idumea will become an untrodden waste; everyone who passes by her will hiss.
verses.30:12: Just as Sodom and Gomorrah and her neighboring cities were overthrown," said the Lord Almighty, "no man will ever settle there, and no son of man will dwell there.
verses.30:13: Look, like a lion he will come up from the midst of the Jordan to the place of Etham, for I will quickly drive them out from her; and set the young men over her. For who is like Me? And who will withstand Me? And who is this shepherd who will stand before My face?"
verses.30:14: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord which He has formed against Idumea, and His plan which He has devised against those who dwell in Teman: "Surely the least of the sheep will be swept away; surely their dwelling place will be made untrodden over her;
verses.30:15: for at the sound of their fall the earth was afraid, and a cry of the sea was not heard."
verses.30:16: Now, like an eagle he will look and stretch out his wings over her strongholds; and the heart of the mighty ones of Idumea in that day will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.30:17: Concerning the sons of Ammon. Thus said the Lord: "Are there no sons in Israel, or is there no one to take possession for them? Why has Melchol taken possession of Gilead, and why will their people dwell in their cities?
verses.30:18: Therefore look, days are coming," declares the Lord, "and I will make the uproar of wars heard against Rabbah; and they will become an untrodden waste and a destruction, and her altars will be burned up with fire, and Israel will take possession of his dominion.
verses.30:19: Wail, Heshbon, for it has perished; cry out, daughters of Rabbah! Wrap yourselves in sackcloth and lament, for Melchol will go into exile, his priests and his rulers together.
verses.30:20: Why do you exult in the plains of the Anakim? Daughter of audacity, who trusts in her treasures, who says, 'Who will come against me?'
verses.30:21: Look, I am bringing terror upon you," said the Lord, "from all your surrounding region, and you will be scattered, each one before his own face; there is no one who gathers."
verses.30:23: Concerning Kedar, queen of the court, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck. Thus said the Lord: "Rise up and go up against Kedar, and fill the sons of Kedem.
verses.30:24: Their tents and their sheep they will take; their garments and all their goods and their camels they will take for themselves; and summon destruction against them on every side.
verses.30:25: Flee! You have gone very deep to settle, you who dwell in the court, for the king of Babylon has formed a counsel against you and has devised a plan.
verses.30:26: Rise up and go up against a tranquil nation, settled at ease, who have no doors, no bolts, no bars; they dwell alone.
verses.30:27: And their camels will become plunder, and the multitude of their livestock for destruction; and I will winnow them to every wind, those who are clipped before their faces; from every side beyond them I will bring their rout," said the Lord.
verses.30:28: And the court will become a haunt of ostriches and untrodden forever; no man will ever settle there, and no son of man will dwell there.
verses.30:29: Concerning Damascus. Themar and Arpad have been put to shame, for they have heard an evil report; they were dismayed, they were enraged; they will by no means be able to rest.
verses.30:30: Damascus has grown feeble; she has turned to flight; trembling has seized her.
verses.30:31: "How has she not forsaken My city? They loved a village.
verses.30:32: Therefore young men will fall in your streets, and all your men of war will fall," declares the Lord,
verses.30:33: "and I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the quarters of the son of Hader."
verses.31:1: Concerning Moab. Thus says the Lord: "Woe upon Nebo, for it has perished; Kiriathaim has been captured; Hamath and Hagath have been put to shame.
verses.31:2: There is no longer healing for Moab, no boasting in Heshbon; one devised evil against her: 'We have cut her off from being a nation, and she will surely cease.' Behind you a sword will march,
verses.31:3: for there is a sound of those crying out from Horonaim, destruction and great shattering;
verses.31:4: Moab has been shattered. Announce to Zoar
verses.31:5: that Haloth has been filled with weeping; he will go up weeping on the road of Horonaim; you have heard a cry of shattering.
verses.31:6: Flee and save your lives, and become like a wild donkey in a wilderness.
verses.31:7: Since you trusted in your strongholds, you also will be seized; and Chemosh will go out into exile, both his priests and his rulers together.
verses.31:8: And destruction will come upon every city; it will by no means be saved; and the valley will perish, and the plain will be utterly destroyed," just as the Lord has spoken.
verses.31:9: Give signs to Moab, for she will surely be set on fire, and all her cities will become an untrodden waste; from where is there an inhabitant for her?
verses.31:10: Cursed is the one who does the works of the Lord negligently, withdrawing his sword from blood.
verses.31:11: Moab has rested from boyhood, and he was trusting in his glory; he has not poured from vessel to vessel, and he has not gone into exile. Therefore his taste has remained in him, and his scent has not failed.
verses.31:12: "Therefore look, his days are coming," declares the Lord, "and I will send to him those who tilt, and they will tilt him, and they will pulverize his vessels, and they will cut his horns to pieces,
verses.31:13: and Moab will be put to shame by Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was put to shame by Bethel, their hope, having trusted in them.
verses.31:14: How will you say, 'We are strong, and a man strong for warfare'?
verses.31:15: Moab has perished, his city, and his chosen young men have gone down to slaughter.
verses.31:16: The day of Moab is near to come, and his evil is very swift.
verses.31:17: Mourn for him, all you around him; all of you, proclaim his name; say, 'How has the glorious staff been shattered, the rod of greatness?'
verses.31:18: Come down from glory and sit in dampness, O inhabitant. Dibon is being wiped out, for Moab has perished; one ravaging your stronghold has come up against you.
verses.31:19: Stand by the road and watch, you who dwell in Aroer, and ask one fleeing and one escaping, and say, 'What has happened?'
verses.31:20: Moab has been put to shame, for he has been shattered; wail and cry out; announce in Arnon that Moab has perished,
verses.31:21: and judgment is coming into the land of Mishor, upon Holon, and Rephas, and Mophas,
verses.31:22: and upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon the house of Diblathaim,
verses.31:23: and upon Kiriathaim, and upon the house of Gamul, and upon the house of Meon,
verses.31:24: and upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of Moab, those far and those near.
verses.31:25: The horn of Moab has been broken, and his arm has been shattered.
verses.31:26: Make him drunk, for he has magnified himself against the Lord; and Moab will clap with his hand, and he also will become an object of laughter.
verses.31:27: And was he not an object of mockery to you, Israel, and found in your thefts, that you were making war against him?
verses.31:28: Those who inhabit Moab left the cities and lived in rocks; they became like doves nesting in rocks at the mouth of a pit.
verses.31:29: And I have heard of the insolence of Moab—he has been exceedingly insolent—his insolence and his arrogance, and his heart has been lifted up;
verses.31:30: but I know his works. Is it not enough for him? Has he not acted thus?
verses.31:31: Therefore wail for Moab on every side; cry out for the men of Kir-hadas of drought.
verses.31:32: Like the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, O vine of Oserema; your branches crossed the sea; the cities of Jazer reached to your summer fruit; upon your grape harvesters destruction has fallen;
verses.31:33: joy and gladness have been swept away from the Moabite land, and wine was in your winepresses; in the morning they did not tread, nor in the afternoon did these do so.
verses.31:34: From the cry of Heshbon to Etam their cities gave their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim, and a message of Salasia; for even the water of Nimrim will become a burnt waste.
verses.31:35: And I will destroy Moab," declares the Lord, "as he goes up upon the altar and burns incense to his gods.
verses.31:36: Therefore the heart of Moab will hum like flutes; My heart will hum like a flute for shorn people; therefore what he acquired has perished from man.
verses.31:37: They will be shaved on every head in every place, and every beard will be shaved, and all hands will beat in mourning, and on every waist there is sackcloth,
verses.31:38: and on all the rooftops of Moab and in her squares—for I have shattered her," declares the Lord, "like a vessel of which there is no need.
verses.31:39: How has she changed? How has Moab turned her back? She has been put to shame, and Moab has become an object of laughter and resentment to all those around her."
verses.31:41: "Ekron has been captured, and the strongholds have been seized,
verses.31:42: and Moab will perish from being a multitude, for he has magnified himself against the Lord.
verses.31:43: A snare and terror and a pit are upon you, you who dwell in Moab.
verses.31:44: The one fleeing from before the terror will fall into the pit, and the one coming up out of the pit will be caught in the snare; for I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of their visitation."
verses.32:15: Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Take the cup of this unmixed wine from My hand, and you will make all the nations to whom I am sending you drink,
verses.32:16: and they will vomit and go mad from before the sword that I am sending among them."
verses.32:17: And I took the cup from the hand of the Lord, and I made the nations drink to whom the Lord sent me:
verses.32:18: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, and the kings of Judah and its rulers, to make them a desolation and an untrodden waste and an object of hissing,
verses.32:19: and Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and his servants, and his nobles,
verses.32:20: and all his people, and all the mixed peoples, and all the kings of the foreigners, Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
verses.32:21: and Idumea, and the Moabite land, and the sons of Ammon,
verses.32:22: and the kings of Tyre, and the kings of Sidon, and the kings who are on the other side of the sea,
verses.32:23: and Dedan, and Teman, and Rosh, and everyone shaved around his face,
verses.32:24: and all the mixed peoples who lodge in the wilderness,
verses.32:25: and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Persians,
verses.32:26: and all the kings from the east, those far and those near, each one with his brother, and all the kingdoms that are on the face of the earth.
verses.32:27: And you will say to them, "Thus says the Lord Almighty: 'Drink, get drunk, and you will vomit and fall, and you will by no means rise from before the sword that I am sending among you.'"
verses.32:28: And it will be that when they are unwilling to accept the cup from your hand to drink, you will say, "Thus says the Lord: 'You will surely drink,
verses.32:29: for in the city upon which My name has been called I am beginning to bring harm, and you will by no means be cleared, for I am summoning a sword upon those who dwell on the earth.'"
verses.32:30: And you will prophesy against them these words, and you will say, "The Lord will utter an oracle from on high; from His holy place He will give His voice; He will utter a word over His place, and these will answer like grape harvesters. And upon those who inhabit the earth destruction has come,
verses.32:31: upon a part of the earth, for the Lord has a judgment among the nations; He Himself enters into judgment with all flesh, and the ungodly have been given over to the sword," says the Lord.
verses.32:32: Thus says the Lord: "Look, evils are coming from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind is going out from the end of the earth,
verses.32:33: and there will be those struck down by the Lord in the day of the Lord from one part of the earth even to another part of the earth; they will by no means be buried; they will become dung on the face of the earth.
verses.32:34: Wail, you shepherds, and cry out, and beat yourselves in mourning, you rams of the sheep, for your days for slaughter have been fulfilled, and you will fall like the choice rams;
verses.32:35: and flight will perish from the shepherds, and deliverance from the rams of the sheep.
verses.32:36: A sound of the cry of the shepherds, and wailing of the sheep and of the rams, for the Lord has destroyed their flocks,
verses.32:37: and the remnants of peace will cease from before the wrath of My fury.
verses.32:38: He has left His lair like a lion, for their land has become an untrodden waste from before the great sword."
verses.33:1: In the beginning of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah, this word came from the Lord.
verses.33:2: Thus says the Lord: "Stand in the court of the house of the Lord, and you shall proclaim to all the Judeans and to all who come to worship in the house of the Lord all the words that I have commanded you to proclaim to them; do not take away a word.
verses.33:3: Perhaps they will listen and turn back, each one from his wicked way, and I will cease from the evils that I am planning to do to them because of their wicked practices.
verses.33:4: And you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord: If you do not listen to Me, to walk in My statutes which I set before you,
verses.33:5: to heed the words of My servants the prophets, whom I send to you at dawn, and I sent them, and you did not listen to Me;
verses.33:6: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make the city a curse for all the nations of all the earth.'"
verses.33:7: And the priests and the false prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.
verses.33:8: And it happened, when Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the false prophets and all the people seized him, saying, "You shall surely die,
verses.33:9: because you have prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, 'This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be made desolate, without inhabitants.'" And all the people were assembled against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.
verses.33:10: And the rulers of Judah heard this word, and they went up from the house of the king to the house of the Lord, and sat at the entrance of the New Gate.
verses.33:11: And the priests and the false prophets said to the rulers and to all the people, "A judgment of death for this man, because he has prophesied against this city, just as you have heard with your ears."
verses.33:12: And Jeremiah spoke to the rulers and to all the people, saying, "The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
verses.33:13: And now, make your ways and your deeds better, and listen to the voice of the Lord, and the Lord will cease from the evils that He has spoken against you.
verses.33:14: And look, I am in your hands; do to me as is beneficial and as is better for you.
verses.33:15: Only, you shall surely know that if you put me to death, you bring innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and upon those who dwell in it; for in truth the Lord has sent me to you to speak all these words into your ears."
verses.33:16: And the rulers and all the people said to the priests and to the false prophets, "There is no judgment of death for this man, because he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
verses.33:17: And some men from the elders of the land rose up and said to all the assembly of the people,
verses.33:18: "Micah the Moreshethite was in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he said to all the people of Judah, 'Thus says the Lord: Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become an untrodden place, and the mountain of the house a forest grove.'
verses.33:19: Did Hezekiah and all Judah put him to death at all? Was it not that they feared the Lord, and that they pleaded before the face of the Lord, and the Lord ceased from the evils that He had spoken against them? And we have done great evils against our own souls."
verses.33:20: And there was a man prophesying in the name of the Lord, Uriah son of Shemaiah, from Kiriath-jearim, and he prophesied concerning this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.33:21: And King Jehoiakim and all the rulers heard all his words, and they sought to kill him; and Uriah heard and went into Egypt.
verses.33:22: And the king sent out men to Egypt,
verses.33:23: and they brought him out from there and brought him in to the king; and he struck him down with a sword, and threw him into the tomb of the sons of his people.
verses.33:24: However, the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that he would not be handed over into the hands of the people, nor put to death.
verses.34:2: Thus says the Lord: "Make bonds and collars, and put them around your neck,
verses.34:3: and you shall send them to the king of Idumea, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the sons of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hands of their messengers who are coming to meet them in Jerusalem, to Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.34:4: And you shall command them to say to their masters, 'Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Thus you shall say to your masters:
verses.34:5: I made the earth by My great strength and by My uplifted arm, and I will give it to whoever seems right in My eyes.
verses.34:6: I have given the earth to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to serve him, and the wild beasts of the field to work for him.
verses.34:8: And the nation and the kingdom, all who will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will punish them with sword and with famine, says the Lord, until they come to an end by his hand.
verses.34:9: And as for you, do not listen to your false prophets, and those who practice divination for you, and those who dream for you, and your omens, and your sorcerers, who say, "You shall by no means work for the king of Babylon,"
verses.34:10: for they prophesy false things to you, in order to remove you far from your land.
verses.34:11: And the nation that brings its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and works for him, I will leave it on its own land; and it shall work for him and dwell in it.'"
verses.34:12: And to Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke according to all these words, saying, "Bring your neck in and work for the king of Babylon.
verses.34:14: For they prophesy unjust things to you,
verses.34:15: for I did not send them, declares the Lord, and they prophesy in My name unjustly in order to destroy you; and you shall perish, you and your prophets who prophesy false things to you unjustly."
verses.34:16: To you and to all this people and to the priests I spoke, saying, "Thus says the Lord: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you, saying, 'Look, the vessels of the house of the Lord will return from Babylon,' for they prophesy unjust things to you; I did not send them.
verses.34:18: If they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is in them, let them meet with Me;
verses.34:19: for thus says the Lord: And concerning the remaining vessels,
verses.34:20: which the king of Babylon did not take when he exiled Jeconiah from Jerusalem,
verses.34:22: they shall go into Babylon, says the Lord."
verses.35:1: And it happened in the fourth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fifth month, that Hananiah son of Azzur, the false prophet from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord before the eyes of the priests and all the people, saying,
verses.35:2: "Thus says the Lord: I have shattered the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.35:3: Two more years of days, and I will bring back to this place the vessels of the house of the Lord,
verses.35:4: and Jeconiah and the exiles of Judah, for I will shatter the yoke of the king of Babylon."
verses.35:5: And Jeremiah spoke to Hananiah before the eyes of all the people and before the eyes of the priests who were standing in the house of the Lord,
verses.35:6: and Jeremiah said, "Truly, may the Lord do so; may He establish your word that you prophesy, to bring back the vessels of the house of the Lord and all the exiles from Babylon to this place.
verses.35:7: However, hear the word of the Lord that I speak into your ears and into the ears of all the people:
verses.35:8: The prophets who were before me and before you from ancient times prophesied against much land and against great kingdoms concerning war;
verses.35:9: as for the prophet who has prophesied concerning peace, when the word comes, they will know the prophet whom the Lord has sent to them in faithfulness."
verses.35:10: And Hananiah took the collars from the neck of Jeremiah before the eyes of all the people and shattered them.
verses.35:11: And Hananiah spoke before the eyes of all the people, saying, "Thus says the Lord: In this way I will shatter the yoke of the king of Babylon from the necks of all the nations." And Jeremiah went off on his way.
verses.35:12: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah after Hananiah had shattered the collars from his neck, saying,
verses.35:13: "Go and speak to Hananiah, saying, 'Thus says the Lord: You have shattered wooden collars, and I will make iron collars in their place.
verses.35:14: For thus says the Lord: I have placed an iron yoke on the neck of all the nations, to work for the king of Babylon.'"
verses.35:15: And Jeremiah said to Hananiah, "The Lord has not sent you, and you have caused this people to trust in what is unjust.
verses.35:16: Therefore, thus says the Lord: Look, I am sending you away from the face of the earth; this year you shall die."
verses.35:17: And he died in the seventh month.
verses.36:1: And these are the words of the scroll that Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the elders of the exile, and to the priests, and to the false prophets—a letter to Babylon for the exiles—and to all the people,
verses.36:2: after Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, and every free man and prisoner and craftsman had gone out from Jerusalem,
verses.36:3: by the hand of Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Babylon in Babylon, saying,
verses.36:4: "Thus says the Lord God of Israel concerning the exiles whom I sent into exile from Jerusalem:
verses.36:5: Build houses and live in them, and plant orchards and eat their fruits,
verses.36:6: and take wives and have sons and daughters, and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, and multiply, and do not be diminished,
verses.36:7: and seek the peace of the land where I sent you into exile, and pray for them to the Lord, for in its peace is your peace.
verses.36:8: For thus says the Lord: Do not let the false prophets who are among you persuade you, and do not let your diviners persuade you, and do not listen to your dreams that you yourselves dream;
verses.36:9: for they prophesy unjust things to you in My name, and I did not send them.
verses.36:10: For thus says the Lord: When seventy years are about to be fulfilled for Babylon, I will visit you and establish My words upon you, to bring your people back to this place,
verses.36:11: and I will plan for you a plan of peace and not evil things, to give you these things.
verses.36:12: And pray to Me, and I will listen to you;
verses.36:13: and seek Me out, and you will find Me; for you will seek Me with all your heart,
verses.36:14: and I will appear to you.
verses.36:15: Because you said, 'The Lord has appointed prophets for us in Babylon,'
verses.36:21: thus says the Lord concerning Ahab and concerning Zedekiah: Look, I am giving them into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will strike them down before your eyes.
verses.36:22: And they will take a curse from them among all the exiles of Judah in Babylon, saying, 'May the Lord do to you as He did to Zedekiah and as to Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in fire,'
verses.36:23: because of the lawlessness that they committed in Israel, and they were committing adultery with the wives of their fellow citizens, and uttered a word in My name that I did not command them; and I am a witness, declares the Lord."
verses.36:24: And to Shemaiah the Elamite you shall say,
verses.36:25: "I did not send you in My name." And to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, the priest, say,
verses.36:26: "The Lord has appointed you as priest in place of Jehoiada the priest, to be an overseer in the house of the Lord over every man who prophesies and every man who is mad, and you shall put him into the prison and into the dungeon.
verses.36:27: And now, why did you join in reviling Jeremiah from Anathoth, who prophesied to you?
verses.36:28: Did he not for this reason send to you in Babylon, saying, 'It is far off; build houses and live in them, and plant gardens, and you will eat their fruit'?"
verses.36:29: And Zephaniah read the scroll in the ears of Jeremiah.
verses.36:30: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.36:31: "Send to the exiles, saying, 'Thus says the Lord concerning Shemaiah the Elamite: Because Shemaiah prophesied to you, and I did not send him, and he made you trust in unjust things,
verses.36:32: therefore thus says the Lord: Look, I will punish Shemaiah and his family, and there will not be a man of them in your midst to see the good things that I will do for you; they will not see them.'"
verses.37:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.37:2: "Thus says the Lord God of Israel, saying, 'Write all the words that I have uttered to you on a scroll.
verses.37:3: For look, days are coming, declares the Lord, and I will turn back the exile of My people Israel and Judah, says the Lord, and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.'"
verses.37:4: And these are the words that the Lord spoke concerning Israel and Judah.
verses.37:5: Thus says the Lord: "You will hear a sound of fear; fear, and there is no peace.
verses.37:6: Ask and see whether a male has given birth, and concerning fear in which they will hold loins and deliverance; because I have seen every man, and his hands are on his loins; faces were turned; they became jaundice.
verses.37:7: For great is that day, and there is none like it; and it is a distressing time for Jacob,
verses.37:8: and from this he will be saved. In that day, says the Lord, I will shatter the yoke from their neck, and I will tear apart their bonds, and they themselves will not serve foreigners,
verses.37:9: and they will serve the Lord their God, and I will raise up David their king for them."
verses.37:12: Thus says the Lord: "I have raised up a fracture; painful is your wound,
verses.37:13: there is no one judging your case; you were treated for pain; there is no benefit for you.
verses.37:14: All your friends have forgotten you; they will by no means inquire; for I struck you with the blow of an enemy, a severe discipline; because of all your injustice, your sins have multiplied.
verses.37:16: Therefore all who eat you will be eaten, and all your enemies will eat all their flesh; because of the multitude of your injustices your sins were multiplied; they did these things to you; and those who plunder you will become plunder, and all who pillage you I will give over to pillage.
verses.37:17: For I will bring up your healing; from a painful wound I will heal you, declares the Lord; because you were called Scattered: 'She is your prey, because there is no one seeking her.'"
verses.37:18: Thus says the Lord: "Look, I will turn back the exile of Jacob, and I will have mercy on his captivity; and a city will be built upon its height, and the people will sit according to its judgment.
verses.37:19: And those who sing will go out from them, a sound of those celebrating; and I will increase them, and they will by no means be diminished.
verses.37:20: And their sons will enter as before, and their testimonies will be set upright before My face; and I will punish those who afflict them,
verses.37:21: and those stronger than he will be over them, and his ruler will go out from him; and I will gather them, and they will return to Me; for who is this who has given his heart to return to Me, declares the Lord?"
verses.37:23: For the furious wrath of the Lord has gone out; a whirling wrath has gone out; it will come upon the ungodly.
verses.37:24: The wrath of the Lord's fury will by no means turn back until He carries out, and until He establishes, the undertaking of His heart; at the end of the days you will know these things.
verses.38:1: "At that time," said the Lord, "I will be God to the family of Israel, and they will be a people to Me."
verses.38:2: Thus said the Lord: "I found warmth in the wilderness with those who perished by the sword; go, and do not destroy Israel."
verses.38:3: The Lord appeared to him from afar: "With an eternal love I have loved you; therefore I have drawn you into compassion.
verses.38:4: For I will build you, and you will be built, virgin Israel; you will take up your tambourine and go out with a gathering of those making merry.
verses.38:5: For you have planted vineyards on the mountains of Samaria; plant and praise,
verses.38:6: for there is a day of calling by those making a defense on the mountains of Ephraim: 'Arise and go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.'"
verses.38:7: For thus said the Lord to Jacob: "Be glad and neigh over the head of the nations; make it heard and praise; say, 'The Lord has saved His people, the remnant of Israel.'
verses.38:8: Look, I am bringing them from the north, and I will gather them from the end of the earth at the feast of Passover; and you will bear a great crowd, and they will return here.
verses.38:9: With weeping they went out, and with consolation I will bring them back, lodging them by channels of water on a straight path, and they will by no means go astray on it; for I have become a father to Israel, and Ephraim is My firstborn."
verses.38:10: Hear the words of the Lord, nations, and declare to the more distant islands; say, "He who winnowed Israel will gather him, and will guard him as one who tends his flock."
verses.38:11: For the Lord has ransomed Jacob; He has rescued him from the hand of those stronger than he.
verses.38:12: And they will come and be glad on Mount Zion, and they will come to the good things of the Lord, to a land of grain and wine and fruits and cattle and sheep; and their soul will be like a fruitful tree, and they will not hunger anymore.
verses.38:13: Then virgins will rejoice in a gathering of young men, and old men will rejoice; and I will turn their mourning into joy, and I will make them glad.
verses.38:14: I will magnify and saturate the soul of the priests, the sons of Levi, and My people will be filled with My good things.
verses.38:15: Thus said the Lord: "A voice was heard in Ramah, of lamentation and weeping and wailing; Rachel, weeping bitterly, was unwilling to cease over her sons, because they are no more."
verses.38:16: Thus said the Lord: "Let your voice cease from weeping, and your eyes from your tears, for there is a reward for your works, and they will return from the land of enemies;
verses.38:17: there is permanence for your children."
verses.38:18: "I have surely heard Ephraim wailing: 'You disciplined me, and I was disciplined; I, like a calf, was not taught. Turn me back, and I will return, for You are the Lord my God.
verses.38:19: For after my captivity I repented, and after I came to know, I groaned over days of shame, and I showed to You that I received reproach from my youth.'
verses.38:20: Ephraim is a beloved son to Me, a delightful child; for because My words are in him, I will surely remember him; therefore I have hastened over him; I will surely have mercy on him," says the Lord.
verses.38:21: Station yourself, Zion, make retribution, set your heart on the shoulders; return by the path on which you went, virgin Israel, return to your cities mourning.
verses.38:22: How long will you turn away, dishonored daughter? For the Lord has created salvation for a new planting; in salvation people will go about.
verses.38:23: For thus said the Lord: "Again they will speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I turn back its captivity: 'Blessed is the Lord upon His righteous, holy mountain';
verses.38:24: and those dwelling in the cities of Judah and in all its land together with a farmer, and it will be lifted up with a flock.
verses.38:25: For I have saturated every thirsty soul, and every hungry soul I have filled."
verses.38:26: Because of this I woke up and looked, and my sleep was sweet to me.
verses.38:27: "Therefore, look, days are coming," says the Lord, "when I will sow Israel and Judah with the seed of man and the seed of beast.
verses.38:28: And it will be that just as I watched over them to tear down and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," says the Lord.
verses.38:29: In those days they will by no means say, "The fathers ate sour grapes, and the teeth of the children were set on edge";
verses.38:30: but each one will die in his own sin, and the teeth of the one who eats the sour grapes will be set on edge.
verses.38:31: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,
verses.38:32: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took hold of their hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not remain in My covenant, and I disregarded them," says the Lord.
verses.38:33: "For this is My covenant that I will make with the house of Israel: After those days," says the Lord, "I will surely put My laws into their mind, and upon their hearts I will write them; and I will be God to them, and they will be a people to Me.
verses.38:34: And they will not teach each one his fellow citizen and each one his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' for all will know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them, because I will be merciful toward their injustices, and their sins I will by no means remember anymore."
verses.38:35: "If heaven is lifted up on high," says the Lord, "and if the foundation of the earth is brought low below, then I will not reject the family of Israel," says the Lord, "for all that they have done."
verses.38:36: Thus said the Lord, who gave the sun for the light of the day, the moon and stars for the light of the night, and a cry in the sea, and its waves roared; the Lord Almighty is His name:
verses.38:37: "If these laws cease from before My face," says the Lord, "then the family of Israel will also cease from being a nation before My face all the days."
verses.38:38: "Look, days are coming," says the Lord, "when a city will be built for the Lord from the Tower of Hanamel to the Corner Gate,
verses.38:39: and its measurement will go out opposite them as far as the hills of Gareb, and it will be encircled all around with chosen stones,
verses.38:40: and all Hasaremoth as far as Nachal Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate on the east, a sanctuary to the Lord; and never again will it fail, and it will by no means be torn down forever."
verses.39:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah in the tenth year of King Zedekiah; this was the eighteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.
verses.39:2: And the army of the king of Babylon laid siege against Jerusalem, and Jeremiah was being kept under guard in the court of the guard, which is in the house of the king,
verses.39:3: in which King Zedekiah had shut him up, saying, "Why do you prophesy, saying, 'Thus says the Lord: Look, I am giving this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will take it,
verses.39:4: and Zedekiah will by no means escape from the hand of the Chaldeans, for he will surely be handed over into the hands of the king of Babylon, and his mouth will speak to his mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes,
verses.39:5: and Zedekiah will enter Babylon, and there he will remain.'"
verses.39:6: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.39:7: "Look, Hanamel son of Shallum, your father's brother, is coming to you, saying, 'Buy for yourself my field that is in Anathoth, for to you belongs the right to receive it as a possession.'"
verses.39:8: And Hanamel son of Samol, my father's brother, came to me into the court of the guard and said, "Buy my field that is in the land of Benjamin, the one in Anathoth, for to you belongs the right to buy it, and you are the elder." And I knew that it was the word of the Lord.
verses.39:9: And I bought the field of Hanamel, the son of my father's brother, and I weighed out to him seven shekels and ten of silver.
verses.39:10: And I wrote in a deed and sealed it, and I called witnesses, and I weighed out the silver on a scale.
verses.39:11: And I took the deed of purchase, the sealed one,
verses.39:12: and I gave it to Baruch son of Neriah, son of Maaseiah, before the eyes of Hanamel, the son of my father's brother, and before the eyes of the men who were standing by and writing in the deed of purchase, and before the eyes of the Jews who were in the court of the guard.
verses.39:13: And I commanded Baruch before their eyes, saying,
verses.39:14: "Thus says the Lord Almighty: Take this deed of purchase and the deed that has been read, and you shall place it in an earthenware vessel, so that it may remain for many days.
